Rich character development, beautiful artwork, and branching narrative paths create an immersive experience where your choices shape the outcome of both romance and the underlying mystery that connects all the worlds together.

title: Angry Birds Trilogy
description: Angry Birds Trilogy brings together the addictive physics-based gameplay of Angry Birds, Angry Birds Seasons, and Angry Birds Rio in one comprehensive package. Players launch colorful birds from a slingshot to destroy structures and defeat egg-stealing pigs across hundreds of levels. The collection features enhanced HD graphics, new cinematics, and trophy support exclusive to the Vita version. Motion controls and touch screen functionality add new ways to aim and fire, while bonus content and unlockables provide extra challenges beyond the original mobile releases.

title: Angry Birds™ Trilogy
description: Angry Birds Trilogy brings together three versions of the blockbuster mobile game series to PlayStation Vita. Players slingshot wingless birds at egg-stealing pigs across hundreds of physics-based puzzle levels from the original Angry Birds, Seasons, and Rio. Each bird possesses unique abilities—some split into multiples, others explode or drop eggs—requiring strategic selection to topple elaborately constructed pig fortresses. The collection features touchscreen controls optimized for Vita, HD graphics, and exclusive bonus levels not found in the mobile versions.

title: Another World
description: Another World drops players into a mysterious alien planet where survival depends on quick reflexes and clever problem-solving. This cinematic platformer follows physicist Lester as he escapes deadly creatures and navigates treacherous environments. Rotoscoped animations bring fluid movement to life as players run, jump, and use an alien weapon to blast through obstacles. The game features no HUD or dialogue, telling its story through atmospheric visuals and environmental storytelling. Each screen presents new challenges requiring precise timing and experimentation to overcome.

title: Another World - 20th Anniversary Edition
description: Another World presents Eric Chahi's cinematic platformer masterpiece with enhanced HD graphics and remastered audio. Players control Lester, a physicist transported to an alien world after a particle accelerator experiment goes catastrophically wrong. Armed only with wit and a powerful alien gun acquired along the way, players navigate hostile environments, solve intricate puzzles, and forge an unlikely bond with an alien companion. The game features fluid rotoscoped animation, atmospheric storytelling without dialogue, and precise platforming challenges that blend action with environmental problem-solving across a mysterious extraterrestrial landscape.

Multiple endings await based on choices made throughout the adventure across diverse environments from forests to mysterious ancient structures.

Master chain-kill combat, stealth mechanics, and parkour navigation through bayous, plantations, and city streets. Experience a personal tale of freedom and justice as you uncover a conspiracy that threatens the future of the New World.

Enhanced with additional characters, unlimited character modes, and new gameplay mechanics, this portable version delivers technical combat that rewards precision timing and strategic play. This 2D fighting game features fast-paced combat with unique character abilities, complex combo systems, and an extensive story mode. Players battle across multiple game modes including Arcade, Story, and online multiplayer, utilizing each character's distinctive Drive abilities and special moves. The game expands the roster with new playable characters while refining the signature high-speed battles and intricate mechanics that define the series.

title: BlazBlue: Chronophantasma Extend
description: BlazBlue: Chronophantasma Extend brings the intense 2D fighting action to PS Vita with an expanded roster of playable characters and multiple story modes. The game features extensive single-player content including Arcade, Story, and Abyss modes, plus online multiplayer battles. With its anime-inspired visuals, complex combo systems, and deep narrative continuing the BlazBlue saga, this definitive edition offers both accessibility for newcomers and depth for competitive players.

title: Block-a-Pix Deluxe
description: Block-a-Pix Deluxe brings the popular picture logic puzzle to PlayStation Vita with over 150 colorful puzzles. Players reveal hidden images by painting blocks according to numerical clues, with each number indicating how many blocks in a group should be filled in. The game features a variety of difficulty levels from simple grids to complex challenges, intuitive touch controls optimized for Vita, and a relaxing soundtrack. Progress through increasingly intricate puzzles that form vibrant pixel art pictures when completed, offering hours of brain-teasing entertainment.

The game features classic 8-bit inspired graphics and gameplay mechanics reminiscent of early Castlevania titles. Switch between characters strategically to overcome environmental obstacles and defeat powerful bosses. Multiple difficulty modes and unlockable content provide additional replay value. The curse of the moon beckons brave warriors to face the darkness.

The game features multiple modes including Score Attack and Time Attack, testing both strategic thinking and quick reflexes. With its minimalist aesthetic and progressively challenging puzzles, Bloxiq offers a cerebral experience that demands careful planning and spatial awareness.

title: BLUE REFLECTION
description: BLUE REFLECTION follows the story of Hinako Shirai, a ballet dancer whose career ends due to injury. As she struggles to adapt to normal school life, she discovers the power to transform into a Reflector and enter a mysterious parallel world. Players engage in turn-based combat, build relationships with classmates, and explore emotional themes as Hinako battles to protect her friends from otherworldly threats. The game features beautiful anime-style visuals, a contemplative soundtrack, and a narrative focused on friendship, loss, and personal growth in this unique magical girl RPG experience.

Bombing Busters
description: Bombing Busters is a modern take on the classic Bomberman formula. Players navigate maze-like stages, strategically placing bombs to destroy obstacles and defeat enemies. The game features both single-player campaign modes and multiplayer battles where up to four players compete to be the last one standing. With colorful graphics and power-ups that enhance bomb range and blast power, players must balance offensive tactics with careful positioning to avoid their own explosions. The game includes various battle arenas and challenge modes that test puzzle-solving skills and reflexes.

title: Bonds of the Skies
description: Bonds of the Skies is a traditional turn-based RPG where players follow a young man who can see bonds between people. When darkness threatens the world, he embarks on a journey with companions to restore balance. The game features classic JRPG mechanics including random encounters, dungeon exploration, and a job system that allows characters to learn different skills. Players navigate through various towns and dungeons, engage in strategic battles, and uncover the mysteries of the spiritual bonds that connect all living things.

Success requires balancing creativity with practical engineering principles.

description: The thrilling conclusion to the Broken Sword saga continues as George Stobbart and Nico Collard pursue a conspiracy rooted in a stolen painting and an ancient Gnostic mystery. This second episode delivers classic point-and-click adventure gameplay with modern refinement, memorable characters, and a gripping narrative that brings the Serpent's Curse story to its dramatic finale.

The game combines precise platforming mechanics with Metroidvania-style exploration, requiring players to master Chelsea's unique abilities including wall-jumping, air-dashing, and time manipulation. Seven deadly bosses await, each demanding pattern recognition and quick reflexes to defeat. With its pixel art aesthetic and punishing difficulty, the game rewards persistence and skill mastery.

Multiple endings and branching paths reveal conspiracy and truth behind the tragedy as time runs out.

description: Burly Men at Sea is a folktale about a trio of large, bearded fishermen who step away from the ordinary to seek adventure. Set in early 20th-century Scandinavia, the game's story branches through player choices, leading to multiple endings across different adventures. Players guide the three brothers through encounters with creatures from folklore, including giants, sirens, and other mythical beings. The hand-drawn art style creates a storybook aesthetic, while the narrative explores themes of curiosity, courage, and Nordic mythology in an interactive experience.

description: Burn the Rope challenges players with a unique physics-based puzzle experience where fire only burns upward. Players must tilt and rotate the screen to keep flames alive as they consume the rope, strategically guiding the fire to burn colored sections and catch bugs for bonus points. Each level presents intricate rope designs that require clever thinking and precise timing. The game features vibrant graphics, increasingly complex puzzles, and special power-ups. Master the art of fire manipulation across numerous levels, each demanding creative solutions to achieve complete rope combustion before the flames die out.

title: Burn the Rope™
description: Burn the Rope challenges players with a unique physics-based puzzle experience where fire must be kept burning by rotating the rope. The flame travels upward, so players must continuously turn their device or adjust the angle to guide it along increasingly complex rope formations. Each level introduces new obstacles, bug enemies that either help or hinder progress, and special power-ups. Strategic thinking and quick reflexes are essential as players work to burn through all the rope before the flame dies out, unlocking new challenges and achievements.

Players engage in covert operations as a CIA operative, experiencing fast-paced combat across multiple environments. The game features a unique campaign designed for portable play, competitive multiplayer modes supporting up to 8 players, and the series' signature progression system. Despite being built specifically for Vita's dual analog controls and touch capabilities, the title received criticism for its short campaign length and technical limitations compared to console entries in the franchise.

Strategic room placement, troop deployment, and precise ballista aim determine victory as players balance offense and defense. With its blend of real-time strategy, resource management, and destructive castle combat, CastleStorm delivers chaotic medieval mayhem.

description: Vincent Brooks faces nightmares both literal and romantic in this enhanced edition. Navigate treacherous tower-climbing puzzles while managing relationships with three women: his girlfriend Katherine, the seductive Catherine, and newcomer Rin. Your choices shape Vincent's fate across multiple endings. The Full Body edition adds new story content, puzzle mechanics, and expanded narrative paths. Anime cutscenes blend with strategic block-pushing gameplay where one wrong move means plummeting to your doom. Confessional sequences reveal other victims' struggles while a mysterious voice judges your answers.

Players engage in wild battles across colorful arenas, choosing from quirky characters wielding outrageous weapons like giant mallets, chainsaws, and freeze rays. The game features multiple modes including Smack Attack, Gate Relay, and Flag Rally, where destruction is the ultimate goal. With its distinctive cel-shaded graphics and slapstick humor inspired by classic cartoons, every crash, explosion, and power-up creates over-the-top chaos as vehicles transform and weapons multiply the pandemonium.

Combat uses a turn-based system with a unique pair-based mechanic where partners can fight separately or combine their powers for devastating team attacks. Players explore dungeons, battle monsters, and uncover the dark secrets behind the tournament while making choices that affect the narrative outcome.

title: Chaos Rings II
description: Chaos Rings II is a prequel to the original Chaos Rings, set 10,000 years before the events of the first game. Players follow the story of a young man who becomes embroiled in a conflict that will determine the fate of humanity. The game features turn-based combat with a unique pair system, stunning 3D graphics, and multiple character perspectives that interweave to tell an epic tale. Originally developed by Media Vision and published by Square Enix, this mobile RPG brings console-quality storytelling and gameplay to handheld devices with an expansive world to explore and challenging battles to overcome.

title: Chaos Rings III
description: Chaos Rings III concludes the acclaimed mobile RPG trilogy with an epic tale spanning thousands of years. Players explore a vast world where humanity faces extinction, commanding a diverse cast of characters in turn-based battles featuring the series' signature gene system. The story weaves together multiple timelines and perspectives as heroes fight against an ancient curse threatening all life. Enhanced visuals and an orchestral soundtrack accompany deep character customization and strategic combat that rewards tactical thinking and party synergy.

Players experience an epic saga spanning three interconnected RPG adventures, each featuring turn-based combat, multiple character perspectives, and intertwining storylines that explore themes of love, sacrifice, and eternal conflict. The games blend traditional Japanese RPG elements with modern storytelling, offering dungeon exploration, character customization, and strategic battles. Originally mobile titles from Square Enix, these enhanced versions deliver a comprehensive journey through the Chaos Rings universe.

Multiple story perspectives reveal different facets of the narrative, while genetic modifications and equipment customization provide depth to character progression.

The game features a unique 'delusion trigger' system allowing players to shape the protagonist's perception of reality, leading to multiple endings. With dark psychological themes and conspiracy elements, it delivers a gripping mystery filled with paranoia and supernatural occurrences.

As days pass, Hiyori must uncover the truth behind their captivity, navigate complex relationships with the masked men, and discover who she can trust. The choices made throughout the investigation determine which romantic route unfolds and whether escape is possible. This otome visual novel combines mystery, suspense, and romance in a dark, theatrical setting.

With bizarre executions, memorable characters, and plot twists that challenge reality itself, this dark visual novel adventure combines investigation gameplay with fast-paced trial sequences where every decision could mean life or death.

title: Day of the Tentacle Remastered
description: Bernard, Hoagie, and Laverne return in this remastered point-and-click adventure classic. Purple Tentacle's quest for world domination sends the trio on a time-traveling journey through history. Players switch between three time periods, solving elaborate puzzles by manipulating objects and events across past, present, and future. The remaster features updated graphics with the ability to switch to original art, rerecorded audio, developer commentary, and concept art galleries. Experience LucasArts' irreverent humor and mind-bending temporal puzzles in this beloved comedy adventure.

This LEGO adventure features open-world exploration, puzzle-solving, and character-switching mechanics. Players build and destroy LEGO environments while unlocking over 50 playable DC characters. The game combines humor with superhero action as the Dynamic Duo protects the city from the villainous alliance threatening to take control of the presidency and wreak havoc across the nation.

title: Lego Batman 3 Beyond Gotham
description: The Caped Crusader joins forces with the super heroes of the DC Comics universe and blasts off to outer space to stop the evil Brainiac from destroying Earth. Using the power of the Lantern Rings, players unlock new characters and abilities as they battle across iconic locations. Build, solve puzzles, and defeat villains in this family-friendly LEGO adventure that combines humor with intergalactic action.

description: Players return to Hogwarts to experience the final years of Harry Potter's education. This Lego adaptation covers the last three books and four films, featuring spell-casting, potion-making, and magical duels. Students explore iconic locations like the Room of Requirement and Godric's Hollow while battling Death Eaters and confronting Voldemort. The game combines humor with the darker themes of the later stories, offering cooperative gameplay where two characters work together to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles using their unique magical abilities.

title: Lego Jurassic World
description: Players relive key moments from all four Jurassic Park films in classic LEGO humor and style. Experience the wonder and thrills of dinosaur encounters while exploring Isla Nublar and Isla Sorna. Play as over 100 unlockable characters including Owen Grady, Claire Dearing, Ian Malcolm, and dinosaurs themselves. Solve puzzles, collect amber bricks, and rebuild iconic scenes with LEGO creativity. The game features drop-in/drop-out cooperative gameplay and brings prehistoric action to portable form with the full LEGO treatment of the beloved franchise.

title: Lego Legends of Chima Laval’s Journey
description: Join Laval and the heroes of Chima in this action-adventure based on the LEGO Legends of Chima universe. Players explore the mystical land of Chima, battling enemies and solving puzzles across various kingdoms. The game features classic LEGO gameplay with building, combat, and exploration elements. Navigate through story-driven missions, unlock new characters and abilities, and harness the power of CHI to overcome challenges. Experience the conflict between animal tribes as you work to restore balance to Chima in this portable LEGO adventure designed for younger players.

title: Lego Marvel's Avengers
description: Players assemble their favorite Marvel superheroes and villains in brick form to relive iconic moments from the Avengers films and comics. The game features over 200 playable characters including Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, and Hulk, each with unique abilities. Players smash, build, and battle through familiar locations from the Marvel Cinematic Universe, solving puzzles and collecting studs in classic LEGO game fashion. The story spans multiple Avengers movies, offering cooperative gameplay where players switch between characters to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies like Ultron and Loki.

title: Lego Ninjago Nindroids

Battle the Digital Overlord and his Nindroids across multiple levels, utilizing each ninja's unique abilities and vehicles. Build and customize LEGO structures, solve puzzles, and engage in combat using Spinjitzu techniques. The game features co-op gameplay, allowing players to switch between different ninja characters as they work to save New Ninjago City from digital domination.

title: Lego Ninjago Shadow Of Ronin
description: Players embark on a ninja adventure as they master the art of Ninjitsu to defend the LEGO Ninjago world. Battle through multiple levels using martial arts moves and elemental powers while solving puzzles. Play as favorite characters including Kai, Cole, Jay, Zane, Lloyd, and Nya. Each ninja possesses unique abilities and weapons. Explore detailed LEGO environments, defeat enemies, collect studs, and unlock new characters. The game features the signature LEGO humor and accessible combat system that appeals to fans of all ages. Face off against the mysterious Ronin and his army of dark samurai warriors.

title: Lego Star Wars The Force Awakens

The game features story levels that follow the film's narrative, plus exclusive content that explores the time between Return of the Jedi and The Force Awakens. Master new combat mechanics including multi-builds and Blaster Battles, while controlling iconic characters like Rey, Finn, Poe Dameron, Han Solo, and BB-8. Build and rebuild structures using LEGO bricks to solve puzzles and progress through diverse locations from the film.

title: Lego The Hobbit
description: Players embark on a journey through Middle-earth, reliving the events of the first two Hobbit films in LEGO form. The game features familiar characters from the franchise as they battle goblins, explore iconic locations like Bag End and the Misty Mountains, and solve environmental puzzles. Combat combines simple attacks with character-specific abilities, while the brick-based world offers destructible environments and collectibles. The adventure supports drop-in/drop-out cooperative play, allowing a second player to join Bilbo, Gandalf, and the company of dwarves on their quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain from the dragon Smaug.

title: Lego The Lord Of The Rings

Players explore iconic locations from the film trilogy, solve puzzles using character abilities, collect studs and treasures, and battle orcs, Uruk-hai and other enemies. The game combines LEGO humor with the epic story of The Lord of The Rings, featuring drop-in/drop-out cooperative gameplay and unlockable characters from across the trilogy.

Features include online leaderboards for competitive scoring and a variety of visual themes that react to the music.

The game features dimension-hopping mechanics, allowing Max to jump between background and foreground layers to navigate challenging levels filled with precise platforming and enemy encounters. With pixel art visuals and chiptune music, players collect water sprites and diamonds across multiple worlds while mastering the jetpack's limited fuel and upgrading abilities.

The game emphasizes precision jumping, careful timing, and pattern recognition as players collect water sprites and power-ups while avoiding deadly enemies and hazards. Each level demands mastery of the core mechanics in this unforgiving retro-style adventure.

title: Muv-Luv
description: Players follow high school student Takeru Shirogane through an intricate science fiction narrative spanning alternate timelines and mecha warfare. This visual novel presents a romantic comedy facade that gradually reveals deeper themes of military conflict, sacrifice, and humanity's struggle for survival against alien forces known as BETA. Multiple story routes explore relationships with different heroines while building toward revelations that connect to the broader Muv-Luv franchise. Each click brings you closer to unlocking achievements and discovering the surprisingly deep lore behind this condiment. With dozens of achievements to unlock and a quirky sense of humor, this casual experience challenges you to click your way through multiple levels of mayo-based progression. Despite its simple premise, the game offers a strangely satisfying gameplay loop that keeps players coming back for just one more click.

title: My Name Is Mayo

Players tap the mayo jar thousands of times to progress through various milestones and discover humorous achievements. The game features simple one-button gameplay with a quirky premise that parodies achievement-hunting culture. Mayo enthusiasts and completionists find themselves drawn into the absurdist loop of clicking condiments. It's a straightforward experience that doesn't take itself seriously, offering a brief diversion for trophy hunters and casual players alike.

Collect resources, expand across multiple islands, and discover rare monster species while composing ever-evolving symphonies. The goal is to create the perfect monster chorus by strategically placing and leveling up creatures, decorating islands, and unlocking new musical combinations. With dozens of monsters to collect and breed, players craft their own musical sanctuary in this charming free-to-play experience.

title: Mystery Chronicle: One Way Heroics
description: Mystery Chronicle: One Way Heroics is a roguelike RPG where players must traverse a constantly scrolling world that's being consumed by darkness from the left side of the screen. Players choose from various character classes and make their way across procedurally generated landscapes, battling monsters, collecting items, and making critical decisions about when to push forward and when to rest. The ever-advancing darkness creates constant tension, forcing players to keep moving or be swallowed by the void. Death is permanent, but players can carry over certain progress between runs through a dimensional vault system.

description: Natural Doctrine is a challenging tactical RPG that demands strategic thinking and careful planning. Players navigate grid-based battlefields where positioning and turn order are critical to survival. The game features a unique link system that allows characters to chain attacks together, creating devastating combinations against enemies. With permadeath mechanics and punishing difficulty, every decision matters as you guide your party through a dark fantasy world filled with monsters and political intrigue. The cross-platform gameplay connects PS Vita, PS3, and PS4 players in a shared tactical experience.

description: Set sail in this historical simulation strategy game where you chart unknown waters during the Age of Discovery. As an admiral in 15th century Portugal, you commission explorers to venture across uncharted seas, seeking new lands and trade routes. Build your trading empire by establishing ports, negotiating with foreign powers, and mapping the world based on explorer reports. The twist: the world's geography changes with each playthrough, creating unique voyages of discovery. Manage resources, recruit legendary admirals, and decide whether reported monsters and myths are real or sailor's tales in this engrossing blend of exploration and commerce.

description: Neon Chrome is a ruthless top-down cyberpunk shooter with rogue-like elements. The game takes place inside an arcology, a massive city-building structure where the overseer must be terminated. Players blast their way through procedurally generated levels using destructible environments, powerful weapons, and cybernetic enhancements. Death is permanent, but assets can be used to upgrade future characters. Each playthrough features different randomized levels, enemies, and loot. Choose from multiple character classes with unique abilities and fight through hordes of enemies in this twin-stick shooter experience set in a dystopian future.

description: NeuroVoider is a twin-stick shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world where your brain has been transferred into a robot body. You blast through procedurally generated levels, collecting loot to upgrade and customize your mech with thousands of possible combinations. The game features fast-paced bullet hell combat, rogue-lite elements with permadeath, and local co-op support. Battle through hordes of robots, face challenging bosses, and experiment with different weapon loadouts and build strategies. Each run offers unique challenges as you fight to uncover the truth behind your transformation in this neon-soaked mechanical dystopia.

title: Neverending Nightmares
description: Neverending Nightmares is a psychological horror game inspired by the developer's real-life struggles with obsessive-compulsive disorder and depression. Players guide Thomas through disturbing dreamscapes filled with grotesque imagery and unsettling scenarios. The hand-drawn art style evokes classic Edward Gorey illustrations, creating a uniquely haunting atmosphere. As Thomas awakens from one nightmare only to find himself in another, players must explore dark corridors and make choices that lead to multiple endings. The game uses minimal color and deliberate pacing to build dread and tension throughout its branching narrative.

Victory goes to the first fighter who reaches their goal, where they are consumed by the mythical Nidhogg worm. The game features frantic sword combat with parries, lunges, and acrobatic dodges across multiple distinct stages. Perfect for competitive local multiplayer matches that blend precision fencing with chaotic momentum shifts.

description: Players take control of Arnice, a half-demon knight who battles the forces of darkness during an endless night that has consumed the world. The action RPG features real-time combat where Arnice fights alongside summoned demon allies called Servan. As players explore the corrupted land, they uncover the mystery behind the perpetual darkness and Arnice's connection to the pure maiden Lilysse. The game combines hack-and-slash combat with strategic demon management and relationship-building elements.

The game features real-time action combat where Alushe fights alongside various demon companions called Servans. Players explore diverse environments, strengthen bonds with allies through a unique Lily system, and engage in fast-paced battles combining swordplay with demon abilities. Multiple endings await based on relationship choices, offering substantial replay value in this dark fantasy adventure.

title: Night Trap - 25th Anniversary Edition
description: Return to the Martins' lakeside estate in this remastered edition of the controversial FMV classic. As a member of the Sega Control Attack Team, you must monitor surveillance cameras and activate traps to protect five teenage girls from Augers—vampiric creatures lurking in the shadows. With newly filmed scenes, multiple endings, and behind-the-scenes documentaries, this anniversary edition preserves the campy horror that made Night Trap a cultural phenomenon while offering enhanced video quality and expanded content for both nostalgic fans and curious newcomers.

title: NightCry
description: NightCry is a survival horror adventure game directed by Hifumi Kono, creator of the classic Clock Tower series. Players explore a cruise ship terrorized by a mysterious scissor-wielding stalker known as the Scissorwalker. The game features multiple playable characters, branching storylines, and emphasizes evasion and puzzle-solving over combat. Death lurks around every corner as players investigate the ship's dark secrets, make critical decisions that affect the narrative, and attempt to survive encounters with relentless pursuers in this spiritual successor to the point-and-click horror classics.

title: Nights of Azure / Yoru no Nai Kuni
description: Players take the role of Arnice, a half-demon knight who battles fiends in a world where the sun no longer rises. Accompanied by her companion Lilysse, she ventures into the eternal night to uncover the mystery behind the dark curse. The game blends fast-paced action combat with demon summoning mechanics, allowing players to command various fiends called Servans in battle. Time management plays a crucial role as players must complete objectives before the dangerous Blood Moon appears, intensifying enemy encounters and environmental hazards.

Players guide Born through atmospheric environments, using colors absorbed from the world to gain new abilities and overcome environmental puzzles and hostile creatures that seek to return him to the Void.

Work odd jobs, complete tasks for officials, and try to secure the documents needed to bring your family to safety. The game explores themes of displacement, isolation, and the refugee experience through its unsettling atmosphere and cryptic gameplay.

Discover new abilities, solve environmental puzzles, and rescue scientists scattered across bizarre planets. The game challenges players to think strategically about each move while managing real-time threats, creating a unique hybrid gameplay experience.

Players choose from various mutant characters, each with unique abilities, and battle through hordes of enemies to reach the Nuclear Throne. The game features intense bullet-hell combat, randomized weapons and mutations, and permadeath mechanics. Every run offers different challenges as players navigate radiation-soaked deserts, frozen cities, and crystalline caves. The tight controls and explosive action demand quick reflexes and strategic weapon choices to survive increasingly dangerous encounters.

Players deploy special abilities, unlock powerful weapons, and upgrade their holy warriors while fighting through waves of enemies. The game features colorful graphics, darkly humorous presentation, and challenging gameplay that tests both reflexes and tactical thinking as the nuns fight to save the world from supernatural evil.

Combat emphasizes fluid swordplay with over 100 unique blades to forge, each possessing distinct abilities and devastating special attacks. As Kisuke and Momohime's intertwining stories unfold, players uncover secrets of betrayal, possession, and the supernatural.

The story follows nine individuals whose lives become intertwined after a mass drowning incident. Through multiple perspectives, you uncover conspiracies involving psychic powers, secret organizations, and supernatural phenomena. The narrative blends science fiction with occult themes as you piece together the truth behind the incidents.

title: Oceanhorn
description: Oceanhorn: Monster of Uncharted Seas is an action-adventure game that follows a young boy on a quest to find his missing father and defeat the living fortress known as Oceanhorn. Players explore islands across a vast ocean, solve environmental puzzles in dungeons, and engage in real-time combat against monsters. The game features a vibrant cel-shaded art style, a sweeping orchestral soundtrack, and gameplay inspired by classic adventure titles. Collect items, upgrade equipment, and uncover the secrets of the Arcadian civilization while sailing between diverse locations filled with treasure and danger.

description: Octodad: Dadliest Catch is a comedic physics-based adventure where players control an octopus masquerading as a human father. Navigate everyday tasks like making coffee, mowing the lawn, and grocery shopping while avoiding detection. The challenging controls simulate the difficulty of an octopus manipulating objects with its tentacles. Complete mundane household chores and embark on family outings to the aquarium, all while maintaining the charade. Features cooperative multiplayer where each player controls different limbs, creating chaotic hilarity.

description: Oddworld: New 'n' Tasty reimagines the classic Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee with stunning visuals and enhanced gameplay. Players guide Abe, a Mudokon slave working at RuptureFarms, as he discovers the horrifying truth about his employers' latest product. Using stealth, puzzle-solving, and the mystical GameSpeak system to communicate with fellow Mudokons, Abe must escape the facility and rescue his people from a terrible fate. This beloved platformer combines challenging puzzles, dark humor, and a unique atmosphere in a complete visual and audio overhaul of the original adventure.

description: You are Stranger, a fearsome bounty hunter tracking outlaws in the Western Mudos wasteland. Armed with a unique double-barreled critter-firing crossbow, you capture live ammunition from the environment and use it to take down targets. Navigate diverse landscapes from small frontier towns to industrial facilities, switching between third-person exploration and first-person combat. The hunter becomes the hunted as you uncover dark secrets about the Mongo River region and confront a truth that changes everything about your mission.

title: Odin Sphere Leifthrasir
description: Players journey through a beautifully hand-drawn 2D world in this enhanced remake of the PlayStation 2 classic. Five interwoven stories follow different protagonists as they navigate the kingdom of Erion during Armageddon. The game features refined real-time combat with combo systems, magical abilities, and boss battles against massive foes. Between battles, players grow ingredients to cook dishes that boost stats and level up characters. Stunning visuals combine with orchestral music to create a dark fairy tale atmosphere, while the expanded storyline adds new content beyond the original game.

With multiple game modes including career, spots, and daily challenges, OlliOlli tests reflexes and skill through its addictive one-more-try gameplay. The minimalist aesthetic and tight controls create an experience that's easy to learn but incredibly difficult to master.

Players must master perfectly timed tricks, grinds, and manuals while maintaining combos through increasingly complex courses. The sequel introduces new moves like reverts and grind switching, adding deeper strategic options to each run. With its pixel-art style and punishing-yet-rewarding gameplay, every level demands precision and creativity as players chase high scores and complete demanding objectives.

description: Omega Labyrinth is a dungeon-crawling RPG featuring roguelike elements where players guide anime-styled heroines through procedurally generated labyrinths. The game combines traditional dungeon exploration mechanics with a unique character progression system tied to the protagonists' physical attributes. Players navigate trap-filled floors, battle monsters, collect loot, and manage resources while uncovering the mysteries of the labyrinth. The turn-based combat and permadeath mechanics demand strategic thinking and careful planning to survive increasingly challenging depths.

title: OMG HD Zombies!
description: OMG HD Zombies! is a top-down action-strategy game where players use strategic zombie placement to trigger devastating chain reactions. A single bullet can start a cascade of zombie attacks as infected enemies turn and attack their former allies. Players navigate through multiple levels, carefully planning shots to maximize carnage and achieve high scores. The game features colorful HD graphics, multiple weapon types, and various zombie types with different behaviors. Success requires precision aiming and creative thinking to create the longest possible chains of zombie mayhem across increasingly challenging stages.

title: One Eyed Kutkh
description: One Eyed Kutkh is a surreal point-and-click adventure game inspired by Slavic mythology. Players guide a seemingly ordinary character through a bizarre, hand-drawn world filled with strange creatures and peculiar scenarios. The game features minimalist puzzle-solving mechanics and a unique art style that blends the grotesque with the whimsical. With its wordless storytelling approach, players must interpret the narrative through visual cues and environmental details. The game's short but memorable journey explores themes of alienation and transformation through its unconventional gameplay and dreamlike atmosphere.

title: One More Dungeon
description: One More Dungeon is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler that combines old-school shooter mechanics with procedurally generated levels. Players navigate through randomly created dungeons filled with monsters, traps, and treasures. The game features permadeath, retro-inspired graphics, and a variety of weapons and magical artifacts to discover. Each run presents a new layout and challenges, requiring quick reflexes and strategic thinking. With its blend of classic dungeon exploration and modern roguelike elements, the game offers high replayability as players attempt to survive increasingly difficult floors and defeat powerful bosses.

title: ONE PIECE BURNING BLOOD
description: ONE PIECE BURNING BLOOD brings the beloved anime and manga series to life in an explosive 3D fighting game. Players engage in intense battles using a diverse roster of characters from the One Piece universe, each with their signature Devil Fruit powers and combat techniques. The game features a unique combat system that emphasizes teamwork and strategy, allowing players to build three-person teams and execute devastating combination attacks. Experience iconic moments from the Marineford War arc and beyond as you master the art of pirate combat in both single-player story mode and competitive multiplayer battles.

Experience dynamic combat with multiple playable characters, each with unique fighting styles and devastating special attacks drawn from the anime series.

The journey features random events, scavenging missions, boss battles, and permanent death mechanics. Survivors must carefully balance food, fuel, ammunition, and the health of their party members while navigating through infested cities and hostile territories in search of a safe haven.

Players take on the role of Fuka, a young woman with amnesia who finds herself in the mysterious town of Oz, where various mafia families based on beloved stories like The Wizard of Oz and Grimm's Fairy Tales vie for control. Through branching storylines and multiple romance routes, players navigate dangerous alliances, uncover the protagonist's lost memories, and explore relationships with a diverse cast of charming yet dangerous individuals in this unique blend of fantasy and crime drama.

title: Papers, Please
description: Papers, Please casts you as an immigration inspector at a border checkpoint in the fictional dystopian country of Arstotzka. You examine documents, check for discrepancies, and decide who to admit or deny entry while balancing moral choices against your family's survival. Each day brings new rules, potential terrorists, and ethical dilemmas. Your decisions have consequences as you struggle to earn enough money for rent, food, and heat while determining the fate of desperate immigrants. The game creates tension through its bureaucratic gameplay and oppressive atmosphere.

Players tap, hold, and scratch to over 25 remixed tracks from the beloved RPG, featuring the Investigation Team in stunning new outfits. Master different difficulty levels across multiple song arrangements while unlocking conversations, costumes, and accessories. Experience a unique story that explores the bonds between SEES members through music and movement in this celebration of Persona 3's unforgettable soundtrack.

title: Persona 4 Golden

Together with friends, they must solve the mystery behind the murders by exploring dungeons, fusing Personas, and balancing daily life as a student. This enhanced Vita version adds new characters, story events, and gameplay features to the beloved RPG classic.

This enhanced Vita version adds new characters, story events, and gameplay features to the beloved JRPG experience.

title: Persona 4: Dancing All Night
description: The Investigation Team takes center stage in this rhythm game spinoff set after Persona 4. Players tap and scratch to the beat as Yu Narukami and friends investigate a mysterious realm connected to the Midnight Stage. The story explores Kanami Mashita's idol career and Rise's past while featuring remixed tracks from Persona 4's beloved soundtrack. Dance battles blend visual novel storytelling with rhythm gameplay, offering multiple difficulty levels and unlockable costumes. Each character brings unique dance styles and special moves to performances across familiar Persona 4 music.

title: Phantasy Star Nova
description: Phantasy Star Nova brings the iconic sci-fi RPG series to PlayStation Vita with a unique blend of action-based combat and party management. Players explore diverse alien worlds, battle massive bosses called Gigantes, and gather resources to craft powerful weapons and items. The game features a customizable protagonist, AI-controlled party members, and a story that expands the Phantasy Star universe. Combat emphasizes real-time action with multiple weapon types and special abilities. Players can tackle missions solo or team up in local ad-hoc multiplayer to take down challenging enemies and uncover the mysteries of the Gran Kingdom.

title: Phantasy Star Online 2
description: Phantasy Star Online 2 brings the legendary online RPG franchise to PS Vita with seamless cross-platform play. Players create custom characters and embark on missions across diverse planets, battling enemies in real-time action combat. The game features extensive character customization, multiple classes with unique playstyles, and cooperative multiplayer for up to 12 players. Regular content updates introduce new quests, areas, and events. As an ARKS operative, you defend the galaxy against the mysterious Falspawn threat while uncovering the secrets of the Photoners' ancient civilization.

title: Phineas and Ferb: Day of Doofenshmirtz
description: Players take control of Agent P in this action-platformer based on the Disney Channel series. Navigate through various levels inspired by the show as you thwart Dr. Doofenshmirtz's latest evil scheme. The game features combat, puzzle-solving, and exploration across multiple environments. Use Agent P's gadgets and abilities to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles. Includes boss battles and unlockable content for fans of the series.

title: Pic-a-Pix Color
description: Pic-a-Pix Color brings the classic nonogram puzzle experience to vibrant life with colorful grids and pixel art. Players use numerical clues along the edges of the grid to deduce which squares to fill in, gradually revealing charming pictures ranging from animals to objects. The game features hundreds of puzzles across multiple difficulty levels, from simple 5x5 grids perfect for beginners to massive 35x30 challenges that test even experienced players. With intuitive touch controls designed specifically for the Vita, relaxing gameplay, and no time pressure, it offers pure logical puzzle-solving satisfaction.

title: Pic-a-Pix Pieces
description: Pic-a-Pix Pieces combines picross-style picture logic puzzles with jigsaw mechanics. Players solve nonogram grids to reveal pixel art images, which then become jigsaw pieces that assemble into larger pictures. The game features hundreds of puzzles across multiple difficulty levels, from simple grids to complex challenges. Each completed puzzle contributes to building elaborate mosaics. With intuitive touch controls optimized for Vita's screen, relaxing puzzle-solving gameplay, and a vast collection of brain-teasing content, it offers portable logic puzzle entertainment for fans of both picross and jigsaw puzzles.

title: Pinball Arcade
description: Pinball Arcade brings authentic recreations of classic pinball tables to your fingertips. Experience meticulously detailed digital versions of real-world machines from pinball history, featuring accurate physics, genuine table artwork, and the same rules and objectives as their physical counterparts. Each table offers unique challenges, multiball modes, and score-chasing opportunities. Perfect your skills across various themed tables, trigger special events, and compete for high scores. The collection celebrates pinball's golden age with faithful reproductions that capture the look, sound, and feel of arcade pinball.

title: Pix The Cat
description: Pix the Cat is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game that challenges players to guide a feline hero through colorful grid-based stages filled with eggs and ducklings. Navigate increasingly complex mazes while rescuing ducklings, avoiding enemies, and chaining together combos for higher scores. The game features multiple modes including the frenetic Arcade mode, competitive Arena battles, and the cerebral Laboratory puzzle challenges. With its vibrant neon aesthetics, pulsing electronic soundtrack, and addictive score-chasing gameplay, Pix the Cat delivers a modern twist on classic arcade action.

title: PixelJunk™ Monsters Ultimate HD
description: PixelJunk Monsters Ultimate HD brings the acclaimed tower defense gameplay to PS Vita with enhanced visuals and all previously released content. Players defend their home base from waves of monsters by building and upgrading defensive towers across varied islands. The game features strategic depth through multiple tower types, each with unique abilities and upgrade paths. Cooperative play allows two players to team up and coordinate their defenses. With its charming art style, addictive gameplay loop, and portable format, this definitive edition challenges players to perfect their defensive strategies across dozens of increasingly difficult stages.

title: PixelJunk™ Shooter Ultimate
description: PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate combines both PixelJunk Shooter games into one complete package. Players pilot a nimble subterranean vehicle through fluid-filled caverns, rescuing scientists trapped in dangerous environments. The game features a unique fluid dynamics system where lava, water, and magnetic liquids interact realistically, creating physics-based puzzles and combat scenarios. Navigate treacherous underground mazes, battle hostile creatures and rogue machines, manage heat levels to avoid overheating, and utilize special weapons and suits to overcome environmental hazards in this arcade-style adventure.

title: Plantera
description: Plantera is a relaxing gardening and farming simulation where players cultivate their own garden ecosystem. Plant crops, raise animals, and harvest resources while helpers automatically gather produce. Expand the garden with new plants and creatures, unlock achievements, and watch the farm grow organically. The game features charming pixel art graphics and casual gameplay that continues even when not actively playing, making it perfect for short sessions or extended cultivation.

title: Plants vs Zombies
description: Plants vs. Zombies brings the addictive tower defense gameplay to PS Vita with touchscreen controls. Players strategically plant an arsenal of zombie-zapping flora to defend their home from wave after wave of undead invaders. Each plant has unique abilities, from explosive Cherry Bombs to freezing Snow Peas, requiring careful resource management and tactical positioning. The game features Adventure mode with dozens of levels, mini-games, puzzles, and survival challenges. Sunlight serves as currency to plant defenses, creating a balance between offensive and defensive strategies as increasingly tough zombies attack across different environments from day to night.

title: PlayStation All-Stars Battle Royale
description: PlayStation All-Stars Battle Royale brings together iconic characters from PlayStation's history in a four-player brawler. Players select from a roster including Kratos, Nathan Drake, Sackboy, and other legendary heroes and villains to battle across interactive stages inspired by classic PlayStation franchises. Combat focuses on building up a Super meter through attacks, then unleashing devastating Super moves to score KOs. Stages dynamically transform as characters fight, merging elements from different PlayStation worlds. Features single-player arcade modes, competitive multiplayer battles, and cross-platform play between PS3 and PS Vita versions.

The combat system focuses on building up super attacks to defeat opponents, offering both single-player campaigns and multiplayer modes. Master each character's unique moveset and special abilities while environments shift and transform with crossover elements from multiple PlayStation universes.

title: PlayStation® All-Stars Battle Royale™ (BETA)
description: PlayStation All-Stars Battle Royale brings together iconic characters from the PlayStation universe in an all-out brawler. Players select from a diverse roster of beloved heroes and villains, each with unique movesets and special attacks, battling across dynamic stages that blend multiple game worlds. Build up your Super meter through combat and unleash devastating finishing moves to score KOs. Features both local and online multiplayer modes where up to four players compete in chaotic free-for-all or team-based matches across interactive arenas filled with hazards and surprises.

title: PlayStation® All-Stars Battle Royale™ (PUBLIC BETA)
description: PlayStation All-Stars Battle Royale brings together iconic characters from PlayStation's history in a frantic four-player brawler. Players choose from a roster of beloved heroes and villains, each with unique movesets and super attacks. Battle across dynamic stages that blend elements from different PlayStation franchises, building up power to unleash devastating finishing moves. The public beta offers early access to test characters, stages, and online multiplayer before the full game's release.

title: PlayStation®Vita Pets
description: PlayStation Vita Pets is a pet simulation game where players adopt and care for their own virtual puppy companion. Through voice commands and touch controls, you train your pet, play mini-games, and explore a fantasy adventure together. Customize your puppy's appearance, teach tricks, and build a bond as you embark on quests to find treasure and uncover secrets. The game combines pet care with light adventure elements, offering activities like treasure hunting and obstacle courses while nurturing your digital companion.

title: Pocket God vs Desert Ashes
description: Pocket God vs Desert Ashes brings turn-based strategy warfare to a world where pygmies and landians clash in tactical combat. Players command armies across diverse battlefields, utilizing special powers and strategic positioning to outwit opponents. The game combines the humor of Pocket God with deep tactical gameplay, featuring multiple unit types, environmental hazards, and power-ups. Engage in single-player campaigns or challenge friends in local multiplayer battles where every move counts and careful planning determines victory.

title: POLARA
description: POLARA is a fast-paced color-switching platformer where players navigate through challenging obstacle courses by switching between red and blue states. As an agent fleeing from a totalitarian regime, you must time precise jumps and color changes to pass through matching barriers while avoiding deadly hazards. The game features over 50 levels of increasing difficulty, testing reflexes and split-second decision-making in a dystopian sci-fi setting with sleek minimalist visuals and an electronic soundtrack.

title: Power Smash 4
description: Power Smash 4 brings professional tennis action to the PS Vita with realistic gameplay mechanics and tournament modes. Players compete in various international tennis competitions, mastering different court surfaces and shot techniques. The game features licensed professional players and authentic venues from the world tennis circuit. Advanced physics simulation captures the nuances of tennis gameplay, from powerful serves to delicate drop shots. Multiple game modes include exhibition matches, career progression, and multiplayer competitions.

title: Pox Nora
description: Pox Nora combines tactical strategy with collectible card game mechanics in a unique fantasy world. Players command champions and cast spells on a hex-based battlefield, utilizing strategic positioning and resource management to defeat opponents. Build custom decks from thousands of runes representing units, spells, relics, and equipment. Engage in asynchronous multiplayer battles where each decision matters, leveraging eight distinct factions with unique abilities and playstyles. The game features both PvP competitive ranked matches and cooperative PvE campaigns, offering deep tactical combat for strategy enthusiasts.

title: Prince of Stride
description: Prince of Stride is a visual novel sports game that puts players into the fast-paced world of parkour racing. As the manager of a high school stride team, you guide athletes through urban environments as they vault over obstacles, leap between rooftops, and race against rival schools. The game blends character-driven storytelling with rhythm-based gameplay mechanics where timing is crucial for executing perfect relays between team members. Build relationships with team members, develop strategies, and lead your squad to victory in the competitive Stride tournament circuit across Japan.

title: Project Root
description: Project Root is a top-down arcade shooter where players pilot the advanced fighter craft, the Valkyrie, through intense combat missions. Fight against a corrupt megacorporation's forces across diverse environments in this twin-stick style shooter. The game features a persistent upgrade system for weapons and abilities, challenging boss battles, and a campaign that blends classic shoot-'em-up action with modern design sensibilities. Master multiple weapon types and tactical approaches to overcome waves of enemies and massive mechanical threats in fast-paced aerial combat.

title: Proteus
description: Proteus is an experimental exploration game where players wander through a procedurally generated island rendered in a distinctive pixelated art style. The world reacts to your presence through dynamic audio that shifts with the seasons and time of day. With no explicit objectives or narrative, players discover the island's secrets at their own pace, experiencing a meditative journey through vibrant landscapes inhabited by strange creatures. Each playthrough generates a unique island with its own ecosystem and musical soundscape, encouraging multiple visits to this contemplative digital wilderness.

title: Psychedelica of the Ashen Hawk
description: Players assume the role of Jed, a young woman disguised as a boy in the town of Okunezato, a place shrouded in mystery and inhabited by half-human, half-monster beings called Yomi. As Jed investigates the town's dark secrets and searches for the mysterious Ashen Hawk, she uncovers truths about her own past. The game features multiple character perspectives, branching storylines, and romantic elements typical of otome visual novels. Players make dialogue choices that affect relationships and determine which of several endings they'll experience.

description: Players find themselves trapped in a mysterious mansion with no memories of how they arrived. As one of several amnesiacs, you must collect butterfly fragments to piece together your forgotten past. This otome visual novel combines romance with mystery as you interact with various characters, make choices that affect relationships and story outcomes, and uncover the dark secrets of the mansion. The branching narrative features multiple routes and endings to discover.

title: PSYCHO-PASS MANDATORY HAPPINESS
description: Set in a dystopian future where the Sibyl System measures citizens' mental states and crime coefficients, you play as an Inspector or Enforcer investigating cases while navigating moral dilemmas. Your choices shape the story as you hunt down latent criminals, question the justice system's infallibility, and forge relationships with your team. Multiple branching paths lead to different endings as you balance duty with humanity in this psychological thriller based on the acclaimed anime series.

title: Puddle
description: Puddle is a physics-based puzzle game where players guide a puddle of fluid through various environments by tilting the world. Navigate through pipes, laboratories, gardens, and human bodies while managing the liquid's volume and avoiding hazards. The game features clever environmental challenges that require precise manipulation of momentum and gravity. With its serene presentation and thoughtful level design, Puddle offers a unique blend of relaxation and spatial problem-solving as you carefully shepherd your precious fluid to each level's goal.

title: Pumped BMX +
description: Pumped BMX + is a fast-paced arcade BMX game where you perform gravity-defying tricks across increasingly challenging courses. Master the art of timing and rhythm as you pull off backflips, tailwhips, and combinations to rack up massive scores. With over 500 challenges spread across 50 levels, you'll need precision and style to complete every objective. The game features tight controls, colorful visuals, and an adrenaline-pumping soundtrack that keeps the momentum high as you progress through multiple worlds of BMX mayhem.

title: PUNCHLINE
description: PUNCHLINE is a visual novel adventure game where you play as Yūta Iridatsu, a high school student whose spirit becomes separated from his body. You must solve puzzles and use ghost powers to investigate a mysterious conspiracy while avoiding seeing girls' panties—if you see them twice, an asteroid will destroy Earth. The game features branching story paths, time travel elements, and quirky anime-style humor as you work to prevent catastrophe and reunite your spirit with your body.

title: Pure Chess™
description: Pure Chess delivers a stunning chess experience with photorealistic graphics and wood-carved pieces rendered in incredible detail. Players engage in classic chess gameplay across multiple beautifully crafted boards and environments, from ornate castle halls to serene outdoor settings. The game features full touch controls, multiple difficulty levels powered by a sophisticated AI, and support for both single-player matches against the computer and local multiplayer. Whether a chess master or casual player, Pure Chess offers an elegant and immersive way to enjoy the timeless game with pristine visuals and smooth gameplay.

title: Putty Squad
description: Players control Putty, a blue blob with stretching abilities, through colorful 2D platforming levels. This remake of the 1992 Amiga classic features over 100 levels filled with enemies to absorb, items to collect, and environmental puzzles to solve. Putty stretches, punches, inflates, and morphs to navigate through various themed worlds, rescuing trapped putty friends called Putty Pals while collecting stars and defeating the evil Dazzledaze. The game combines exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving with vibrant visuals and quirky humor.

Players can engage in competitive or cooperative play across multiple game modes that blend Puyo Puyo's colorful blob-matching gameplay with Tetris' iconic block-stacking mechanics. The game features both single-player Adventure mode with story-driven challenges and multiplayer battles supporting up to four players. With ten unique characters, various rule sets including Swap mode that alternates between both puzzle styles, and Big Bang mode for head-to-head showdowns, the title offers accessible fun for newcomers while providing depth for puzzle game veterans.

title: Q*bert Rebooted
description: Q*bert hops back into action in this modern reimagining of the classic arcade puzzler. Players guide the orange protagonist across a pyramid of cubes, changing their colors while avoiding enemies like Coily the snake and Ugg and Wrongway. This rebooted version features both classic and new gameplay modes with updated visuals, introducing hexagonal levels and new mechanics alongside the original arcade experience. Fast-paced action combines with strategic planning as you dodge foes, collect power-ups, and rack up high scores across increasingly challenging stages.

title: Quell Memento
description: Guide a droplet of water through intricate zen-inspired puzzle chambers. Collect pearls scattered across tranquil environments while avoiding obstacles and finding the optimal path to completion. This meditative puzzler combines elegant minimalist design with increasingly challenging levels that test spatial reasoning and planning skills. Features soothing ambient music and atmospheric visuals that create a peaceful yet mentally engaging experience. Each puzzle offers multiple solutions, encouraging creative problem-solving and rewarding efficient navigation through its contemplative challenges.

title: Rabi-Ribi
description: Players control Erina, a bunny girl who wakes up in a mysterious world filled with anthropomorphic creatures. This bullet-hell metroidvania combines intense boss battles with exploration and platforming. Navigate interconnected areas, discover new abilities, and uncover the secrets of Rabi-Ribi Island. The game features multiple difficulty levels, extensive item customization, and numerous challenging boss encounters that test reflexes and pattern recognition. With its blend of cute aesthetics and hardcore gameplay mechanics, it offers a unique experience for fans of action platformers.

title: Race The Sun
description: Players pilot a solar-powered craft through a procedurally generated landscape, racing against the setting sun. The game challenges reflexes as you dodge obstacles, collect power-ups, and navigate treacherous terrain at high speeds. Each run is different thanks to dynamic level generation, while persistent upgrades allow you to extend your survival time. The minimalist aesthetic and trance-inducing gameplay create an addictive experience where success depends on split-second decisions and perfect timing.

description: A visual novel mystery that combines Japanese folklore with werewolf-style social deduction gameplay. Players follow Haruaki Fusaishi as he becomes trapped in a remote mountain village caught in a deadly cycle of supernatural events. The Feast of the Yomi-Purge forces villagers into a brutal game where werewolves hunt humans each night. Through multiple story branches and the innovative Revelation and Guess systems, players uncover the truth behind the village's dark secrets and attempt to break the time loop.

title: Ragnarok Odyssey
description: Ragnarok Odyssey is an action RPG that brings monster hunting to the PlayStation Vita. Players choose from six unique job classes and embark on quests to battle massive monsters in the war-torn land of Rune Midgard. The game features fast-paced combat with combo attacks, customizable abilities through cards, and cooperative multiplayer for up to four players. Inspired by Norse mythology and the Ragnarok Online universe, players face enormous boss creatures that tower over the battlefield, requiring strategic teamwork and skillful execution to defeat.

Players choose from six customizable character classes to battle giant monsters and mythological creatures in fast-paced combat. The ACE edition includes new dungeons, weapons, monsters, and the Yggdrasil Tower survival mode. Players can team up in online co-op for up to four hunters, customize their mercenary with extensive equipment options, and take on challenging boss encounters. Features refined combat mechanics, expanded character customization, and additional post-game content.

title: Rainbow Moon
description: Rainbow Moon is a tactical role-playing game that combines dungeon crawling with strategic turn-based combat. Players guide Baldren through a fantasy world after being banished to Rainbow Moon, battling monsters across vast landscapes. The game features deep character customization, extensive looting systems, and hundreds of quests. With its grid-based combat requiring careful positioning and skill management, players must build their party and optimize equipment to overcome increasingly challenging encounters in this expansive adventure.

title: Rainbow Skies
description: Rainbow Skies is a tactical RPG that challenges players to explore a vast fantasy world filled with monsters, dungeons, and treasures. Players control Damion and his companions as they navigate turn-based battles on grid-based maps, level up characters, craft items, and master elemental magic. The game features extensive character customization, monster taming mechanics, and hundreds of quests across colorful environments. With deep strategic combat requiring careful positioning and skill management, players must build their party's strength to overcome increasingly difficult challenges and uncover the mysteries of this expansive adventure.

title: Ratchet & Clank
description: The Lombax and his robot companion return in this PS Vita reimagining of the original PlayStation 2 adventure. Players blast through alien worlds with an arsenal of creative weapons, collect bolts to purchase upgrades, and uncover the villainous Chairman Drek's plot to create a new planet from the best parts of others. The game combines run-and-gun action with precision platforming across diverse environments, featuring the series' signature humor and gadget-based gameplay optimized for handheld play.

title: Ratchet & Clank 2
description: Ratchet and Clank return in this PlayStation Vita port of the classic PlayStation 2 adventure. Players guide the Lombax mechanic and his robotic companion through diverse planets, wielding an arsenal of creative weapons from the RYNO to the Sheepinator. This portable version preserves the series' signature blend of run-and-gun combat, gadget-based puzzle solving, and platforming challenges. Collect bolts to upgrade weapons, discover hidden gold bolts, and battle through Thugs-4-Less mercenaries and other enemies across multiple star systems in this beloved action-platformer.

title: Ratchet & Clank 3
description: Ratchet and Clank return in this Vita port of the PlayStation 2 classic. Players control the lombax hero and his robot companion as they battle across diverse planets, wielding an arsenal of creative weapons and gadgets. The game combines fast-paced shooting with platforming challenges, humor-filled storytelling, and the series' signature weapon upgrade system. Experience the duo's third adventure with enhanced visuals optimized for handheld play.

title: Ratchet & Clank Collection™
description: This collection brings three classic Ratchet & Clank adventures to PS Vita with remastered HD graphics. Players control the Lombax mechanic and his robot companion through expansive worlds, wielding an arsenal of creative weapons and gadgets. The compilation includes the original Ratchet & Clank, Going Commando, and Up Your Arsenal, featuring platforming action, weapon upgrading systems, and trademark humor. Each game combines exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving as the duo battles Chairman Drek, helps the Galactic Rangers, and uncovers conspiracies across multiple planets in this portable collection.

title: Ratchet & Clank Trilogy
description: Experience three classic Ratchet & Clank adventures on the go. This compilation brings the original trilogy to PS Vita with enhanced graphics and touchscreen controls. Players join the Lombax mechanic and his robot companion across multiple galaxies, wielding an arsenal of creative weapons and gadgets. Each game features distinct storylines involving galactic threats, from Chairman Drek's planet destruction to Dr. Nefarious's organic elimination schemes. The collection showcases the series' signature blend of combat, platforming, and humor across varied alien worlds.

title: Ratchet & Clank: Full Frontal Assault
description: Ratchet and Clank defend their home base against waves of invading enemies in this tower defense-style adventure. Players construct defensive structures, upgrade weapons, and battle through hostile territory in both single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes. The Galactic Rangers face off against Stuart Zurgo and his army across multiple planets, combining strategic base defense with the franchise's signature run-and-gun action. Features cross-play functionality between PS Vita and PlayStation 3 versions.

title: Ratchet & Clank: Q-Force
description: Ratchet & Clank: Q-Force (known as Full Frontal Assault in North America) brings tower defense mechanics to the classic platforming action series. Players defend their base from waves of enemies while simultaneously attacking opponent bases across compact, arena-style maps. The game features the franchise's signature weapons arsenal and combines strategic base management with fast-paced combat. Cooperative and competitive multiplayer modes add variety to the traditional Ratchet & Clank formula, offering both solo and team-based experiences in this compact spin-off adventure.

title: Ratchet and Clank : QForce
description: Ratchet and Clank return in this tower defense-inspired entry where players construct defensive fortifications while engaging in traditional run-and-gun combat. The lombax-robot duo must protect strategic bases across multiple planets from waves of enemies using an arsenal of creative weapons and defensive structures. Features cooperative multiplayer modes and competitive battles, blending the series' signature humor and action with strategic base-building gameplay elements in a compact adventure.

title: Ray Gigant
description: Players dive into a dungeon-crawling RPG where humanity's last hope rests with Gigants—massive spiritual weapons wielded by chosen youth. Navigate labyrinthine dungeons, engage in strategic turn-based battles, and manage a unique rhythm-based attack system. The story follows three protagonists across different timelines as they uncover the mystery behind the Gigants and the parasitic creatures threatening mankind's existence. Features anime-style visuals, multiple character perspectives, and a distinctive battle mechanic that blends traditional RPG elements with timing-based gameplay.

title: RAYGIGANT
description: Ray Gigant is a dungeon-crawling RPG where humanity fights against massive creatures called Gigants using special powers. Players control multiple protagonists who wield the Yorigami, parasitic beings that grant incredible abilities at a cost. The game features a unique rhythm-based Slash Beat Mode combat system, strategic party management, and exploration of labyrinthine dungeons. With its dark atmosphere and compelling narrative about sacrifice and survival, Ray Gigant challenges players to balance power with the corruption it brings while uncovering the mysteries behind the Gigant invasion.

title: Rayman Legends
description: Rayman and his friends embark on a legendary adventure to save the Glade of Dreams from an invasion of nightmarish creatures. Players run, jump, and slap their way through vibrant hand-drawn worlds filled with musical rhythm stages and creative platforming challenges. The Vita version includes exclusive touchscreen gameplay, over 40 rescued characters from Rayman Origins, and features both single-player and local multiplayer modes. With hundreds of levels to master and daily challenges to conquer, this critically acclaimed platformer delivers precise controls and imaginative level design that rewards both casual exploration and speedrunning expertise.

title: Rayman Legends + Rayman Origins
description: This dual-game collection brings two beloved Rayman adventures to PS Vita. In Rayman Origins, players run, jump, and slap their way through a vibrant hand-drawn world to save the Glade of Dreams. Rayman Legends expands the experience with new musical levels, legendary heroes to unlock, and innovative touchscreen gameplay. Both games feature gorgeous 2D graphics, tight platforming controls, and cooperative multiplayer. Players explore imaginative environments, defeat quirky enemies, and rescue Electoons and Teensies across hundreds of levels filled with secrets and challenges.

title: Rayman® Origins
description: Rayman and his friends return in a vibrant 2D platforming adventure bursting with imagination. Players run, jump, and slap their way through lush hand-drawn environments filled with secrets and challenging levels. The game features both single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes where up to four players can team up to rescue the Electoons and save the Glade of Dreams. With its fluid animation, whimsical art style, and tight controls, this platformer offers a challenging yet rewarding experience that celebrates the genre's golden age while delivering fresh gameplay mechanics.

title: Re:BIRTHDAY SONG ～Koi o Utau Shinigami～ another record
description: A romantic visual novel where you play as a shinigami (god of death) who must collect departed souls while forming relationships with various male characters. The game features multiple routes and endings as you navigate between your duties as a reaper and the emotional connections you develop. This enhanced "another record" version includes additional content and improvements over the original PSP release.

title: Re:Zero - kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu - Death or Kiss
description: Players enter the world of Re:Zero as Subaru Natsuki in this visual novel adventure. Navigate complex relationships with Emilia, Rem, Ram, and other beloved characters through branching story paths and romantic encounters. Experience an original story set in the Re:Zero universe, making critical choices that determine which heroine's route you'll follow. The game features full voice acting and multiple endings based on your decisions throughout this death-defying romance.

title: Real Boxing™
description: Real Boxing brings the intensity of professional boxing to your fingertips with stunning Unreal Engine-powered graphics. Step into the ring as you create and customize your own fighter, then battle your way through a career mode filled with challenging opponents. Master the intuitive touch controls to unleash devastating combinations, defensive maneuvers, and knockout punches. Train your boxer between fights to improve stats and unlock new gear. Compete in quick matches or work through the full campaign to become the undisputed champion in this mobile boxing experience.

title: Reality Fighters™
description: Reality Fighters is an augmented reality fighting game that uses the PS Vita's cameras to place fighters into real-world environments. Players create custom fighters using photos of themselves or others, then battle across various locations captured through the camera. The game features multiple fighting styles including kung fu, wrestling, and muay thai, with special moves and power-ups scattered throughout AR battlegrounds. Matches blend real and virtual elements as fighters duke it out in your living room, backyard, or any environment you choose to photograph.

description: A romantic visual novel set on the sunny beaches of a tropical resort. Players take on the role of a young man who encounters various charming female characters during his summer vacation. Through choices and interactions, relationships develop as you navigate beach activities, conversations, and special events. The Gold Beach edition features enhanced content and additional scenarios not found in the original release, offering multiple romance routes to explore.

title: Red Bow
description: Red Bow is a top-down, narrative-driven horror adventure game. Players guide a young girl named Roh through a mysterious and eerie world filled with puzzles and unsettling encounters. The game features pixel art graphics and multiple endings based on player choices. As Roh searches for her missing mother, she must navigate through dark forests, abandoned buildings, and supernatural phenomena. The atmospheric storytelling and psychological horror elements create a tense experience where every decision matters and impacts the final outcome.
