description: Cast your line into the waters as you experience realistic fishing simulation on PlayStation Vita. Master's Challenge brings the art of angling to your handheld with intuitive touch controls and motion sensing. Choose from a variety of fishing spots, select the right tackle and bait, then test your skills against numerous fish species. The game features tournament modes where you compete for the biggest catch, while realistic physics simulate the fight between angler and fish. Build your collection of trophy catches and unlock new equipment as you progress from novice to master fisherman.

title: Refrain no Chika Meikyuu to Majo no Ryodan
description: Players delve into a mysterious labyrinth alongside a coven of witches in this dungeon-crawling RPG. The game combines traditional roguelike mechanics with visual novel elements, as players navigate procedurally generated dungeons while unraveling the story of the witches and their connection to the maze. Strategic combat and resource management are essential as players descend deeper into the labyrinth, encountering increasingly dangerous foes and uncovering the secrets hidden within its depths.

title: Resident Evil: Revelations 2
description: Players return to the world of survival horror in this episodic sequel that follows Claire Redfield and Barry Burton as they investigate a mysterious island. The game features cooperative gameplay, resource management, and intense combat against terrifying creatures. With multiple playable characters and branching storylines, players must work together to uncover the truth behind a sinister experiment while battling through claustrophobic environments filled with deadly enemies and environmental hazards.

title: Resistance: Burning Skies
description: Players step into the boots of firefighter Tom Riley as he battles a Chimera invasion in this portable first-person shooter. Set during an alternate 1950s timeline, Riley must protect his family while fighting through infected zones across the American East Coast. The game features touch-screen controls for interacting with weapons and special abilities, utilizing the Vita's unique capabilities. Engage in intense firefights against Chimera forces, deploy secondary fire modes, and utilize cover mechanics to survive the onslaught in this handheld entry of the Resistance franchise.

Battle through iconic NYC locations overtaken by alien forces, wielding the series' signature weapons including the Bullseye and Auger. The campaign follows Riley's desperate fight to save his family while humanity makes its last stand against overwhelming odds.

title: RESOGUN
description: RESOGUN is a fast-paced side-scrolling shooter where players pilot agile ships through cylindrical worlds wrapped around 3D space. Destroy waves of enemies, save the last humans from abduction, and unleash devastating special attacks including overdrive and bombs. Master the frantic arcade action across multiple difficulty levels while chasing high scores and competing on global leaderboards. The voxel-based graphics explode in spectacular fashion as enemies shatter into thousands of particles.

title: RESOGUN™
description: RESOGUN is a fast-paced arcade shooter that combines classic side-scrolling action with modern visuals and intense gameplay. Players pilot a sleek ship through cylindrical levels wrapped around a 3D axis, destroying waves of alien invaders while rescuing the last humans. The game features spectacular voxel-based explosions, strategic use of limited special abilities like boost and overdrive, and increasingly challenging enemy patterns. With multiple ships to unlock, local co-op support, and addictive score-chasing gameplay, RESOGUN delivers a thrilling homage to classic shooters with stunning next-gen presentation.

title: Retro City Rampage
description: Retro City Rampage is an open-world action game that parodies 1980s and 1990s pop culture, video games, and action films. Players take on the role of a henchman caught in a time-traveling adventure across multiple eras. The game features a massive city to explore, dozens of story missions, and over 200 arcade challenges. With its 8-bit art style and chiptune soundtrack, it delivers chaotic vehicular combat, on-foot mayhem, and countless references to classic games and movies. Players can steal vehicles, complete challenges, customize their character, and cause destruction throughout the nostalgic sandbox environment.

title: Retro City Rampage DX
description: Retro City Rampage DX is an open-world action game that parodies 1980s and 1990s pop culture. Players wreak havoc across a sprawling city filled with over 60 story missions and arcade challenges. The game features destructible environments, numerous vehicles to commandeer, and a vast arsenal of weapons. Packed with references to classic games, movies, and TV shows, it offers both a story campaign following a time-traveling criminal and various mini-games. The DX version includes enhanced visuals, new content, and gameplay refinements over the original release.

title: Retro City Rampage™
description: Retro City Rampage is an open-world action game that parodies 1980s and 1990s pop culture, video games, and action movies. Players navigate a sprawling city completing story missions and side activities inspired by classic NES-era gameplay. The game features countless references to retro gaming culture, with missions that spoof everything from Metal Gear to Mega Man. Combat combines run-and-gun shooting with vehicular mayhem across a destructible urban playground. Over 60 arcade challenges, numerous character customizations, and multiple gameplay modes provide extensive content beyond the satirical story campaign.

title: Revenant Dogma
description: Revenant Dogma is a turn-based RPG from EXE Create. Players follow a story involving transformation between human and revenant forms. The game features traditional JRPG combat mechanics with strategic turn-based battles, character progression, and equipment management. Multiple party members join the quest, each with unique abilities. The narrative explores themes of life, death, and transformation as players navigate dungeons and face various enemies while uncovering the mysteries of the revenant power.

title: Revenant Saga
description: Players embark on a dark fantasy journey in this traditional turn-based RPG. The story follows a tale of transformation and consequence as heroes battle through a world threatened by an ancient evil. Strategic combat involves managing resources and exploiting enemy weaknesses while uncovering the mysteries behind the Revenant curse. Character development and equipment customization provide tactical depth as the party grows stronger through their adventure.

title: Reverie
description: Reverie is an action-adventure game set in New Zealand that pays homage to classic titles like The Legend of Zelda. Players control Tai, a young boy visiting his grandparents on Toromi Island, who becomes entangled in a supernatural mystery. Armed with various weapons including a cricket bat and spirit items, Tai must explore dungeons, solve environmental puzzles, and battle ghostly enemies inspired by Maori mythology. The game features a colorful pixel art style, challenging boss fights, and a charming narrative that blends childhood nostalgia with Pacific folklore.

title: Rewrite
description: Players follow high school student Kotarou Tennouji as he investigates supernatural mysteries in his city alongside a group of girls with hidden powers. This visual novel features branching story paths, romance elements, and a narrative that explores themes of environmentalism and humanity's relationship with nature. The story combines slice-of-life school scenarios with fantasy elements as Kotarou uncovers deeper conspiracies involving Gaia and Guardian, two organizations with opposing ideologies about Earth's future.

title: Riddled Corpses EX
description: Riddled Corpses EX is a twin-stick shooter where players battle endless waves of undead creatures across multiple stages. Choose from six unique characters, each with distinct abilities and playstyles, as you fight through increasingly challenging levels. Collect gold to upgrade weapons and stats between runs, unlocking new characters and improving your chances of survival. The game features pixel art graphics with gore-filled action, combining roguelike elements with arcade-style gameplay. Face off against powerful bosses and compete for high scores in this bullet hell experience designed for fans of classic arcade shooters.

title: RIDGE RACER
description: Ridge Racer launches as a PlayStation Vita launch title, bringing the arcade racing franchise to Sony's new handheld. Players drift through courses at high speeds, utilizing the series' signature handling mechanics. The game features multiple racing modes, unlockable cars, and tracks designed to showcase the Vita's graphical capabilities. Career mode challenges racers to master drifting techniques while competing against AI opponents. Online multiplayer allows for competitive races against other Vita owners, extending the arcade-style racing experience beyond single-player content.

title: Ridge Racer
description: Ridge Racer brings the legendary arcade racing franchise to PlayStation Vita as a launch title. Players drift through courses at breakneck speeds, earning nitrous boosts by maintaining long, controlled slides around corners. The game features both new tracks and remixed favorites from previous entries, with online multiplayer modes and global leaderboards. The Vita's hardware enables detailed graphics and responsive touch controls for menu navigation, while maintaining the series' signature focus on pure, arcade-style racing action without realistic driving physics.

title: Risk of Rain
description: Risk of Rain is a roguelike action-platformer where players fight through procedurally generated levels filled with monsters and bosses. As time passes, the difficulty continuously increases, forcing players to balance exploration with urgency. Choose from multiple unlockable characters, each with unique abilities, and collect hundreds of items that stack to create powerful combinations. Every run is different, with randomized stages, enemies, and loot creating endless replayability. Master the timing-based combat, discover secrets, and attempt to escape the alien planet before the escalating danger becomes overwhelming.

title: Robotics;Notes Elite
description: Dive into a thrilling science adventure visual novel set in 2019 Tokyo. Follow Kaito Yashio and the robotics club members as they uncover a massive conspiracy while pursuing their dream of completing a giant robot. Investigate mysterious incidents, decode cryptic messages, and use the innovative PokeCom system to gather intelligence. Experience a gripping story of friendship, determination, and world-altering secrets in this entry of the Science Adventure series. Multiple endings await based on your choices throughout this suspenseful narrative.

Armed with a laser rifle, Victoria must blast her way through waves of alien enemies and robots across maze-like levels filled with secrets and collectibles. The game combines classic arcade-style shooting with puzzle-solving elements as players navigate tight corridors, avoid deadly traps, and uncover the mystery of the British expedition to the Red Planet. With its distinctive 8-bit aesthetic and challenging gameplay, this director's cut edition includes enhanced features and additional content.

title: Rocketbirds 2: Evolution
description: In this action-packed sequel, players control Hardboiled Chicken and his squad of elite rescue birds on a mission to free captured citizens and overthrow the oppressive Putzki regime. The game features cooperative multiplayer gameplay, allowing two players to team up locally or online. Players navigate through vibrant 2D environments, utilizing a variety of weapons and special abilities to defeat enemies. The game combines platforming challenges with run-and-gun combat mechanics, while adding new features like character customization and cooperative puzzle-solving elements that weren't present in the original.

The game features multiple playable characters from rival shinobi academies, each with unique fighting styles and special abilities. Combat combines aerial techniques, transformation sequences, and over-the-top attacks as students compete to prove their school's superiority. Story mode follows several intertwining narratives exploring the relationships and rivalries between the ninja clans.

title: Senran Kagura: Shinovi Versus ~Shoujotachi no Shoumei~
description: Players control kunoichi from rival ninja academies in fast-paced 3D battles. Transform into powerful Shinobi forms to unleash devastating attacks against waves of enemies. The story follows four ninja factions vying for supremacy, with each character offering unique combat styles and special abilities. Features both single-player story missions and competitive multiplayer modes where players can test their skills against others.

title: Sense - A Cyberpunk Ghost Story
description: Players follow Mei Lin Mak, a young woman investigating supernatural occurrences in a futuristic Neo-Hong Kong. This visual novel combines cyberpunk aesthetics with Asian ghost folklore, presenting a mystery where technology and the paranormal collide. As Mei explores haunted locations within a towering apartment complex, she uncovers dark secrets while encountering restless spirits. The game blends detective work with horror elements, requiring players to piece together clues about mysterious deaths while navigating both the neon-lit streets and spirit world of this dystopian setting.

Severed
description: Severed is a first-person dungeon crawler where you control a one-armed warrior named Sasha seeking her family in a surreal nightmare world. Using touch controls, you swipe to slash enemies in strategic combat, targeting specific limbs and body parts. Defeat monsters to sever their parts and upgrade your abilities through a skill tree system. Navigate labyrinthine dungeons filled with challenging enemies and bosses. The game features a distinctive art style with vivid colors and grotesque creature designs. Explore interconnected areas, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the dark story of Sasha's quest.

The game features cartoon-style graphics and physics-based combat as knights compete across various arenas. Players must time their strikes and manage their balance while galloping toward enemies. The Vita version includes touch controls for aiming and special moves. Multiple game modes offer quick matches and longer tournament campaigns with upgradeable equipment and mounts.

title: Shakedown Hawaii
description: Players take control of a CEO building a business empire across a vibrant open-world island paradise. The game combines old-school arcade action with modern open-world gameplay as players complete missions, acquire properties, and expand their corporate reach through various means both legitimate and otherwise. Featuring destructible environments, vehicular mayhem, and a satirical take on business culture, this retro-styled adventure offers fast-paced gameplay reminiscent of classic 16-bit era titles while delivering a contemporary commentary on commerce and capitalism.

title: Shantae: Half-Genie Hero
description: Shantae embarks on her latest adventure to foil the plans of her nemesis, Risky Boots. As a half-genie guardian, she uses her hair-whip attacks and belly dancing magic to transform into various creatures with unique abilities. Players explore colorful environments, battle enemies, collect items, and solve puzzles across multiple chapters. The game features vibrant hand-drawn animation, challenging boss fights, and optional objectives. Shantae can acquire new transformations and upgrades to access previously unreachable areas, encouraging exploration and replay.

The story blends supernatural elements with detective work as you gather clues, interview witnesses, and make critical choices that affect the narrative's direction. The game features multiple endings based on your decisions, atmospheric presentation, and a focus on psychological horror rather than action. Originally released exclusively in Japan for the PS Vita.

title: Shin Kamaitachi no Yoru 11 Hitome no Suspect
description: Players step into a chilling mystery where a series of murders unfolds at a ski resort. As the eleventh suspect in the Kamaitachi no Yoru series, you must investigate crime scenes, interrogate witnesses, and piece together clues to identify the killer before becoming the next victim. The game features multiple branching paths and endings based on your choices, with atmospheric storytelling that blends horror and detective elements in classic Japanese adventure game style.

title: Shin Sangoku Musou 7 Empires
description: Command vast armies and forge your own empire in this tactical action game set during China's Three Kingdoms period. Players select from numerous officers to lead their forces, engage in large-scale battles featuring hundreds of on-screen enemies, and build relationships through a robust edit mode. Strategic empire management combines with the series' signature musou combat, allowing you to conquer territories, form alliances, and shape the fate of ancient China through both military might and political maneuvering.

title: Shin Sangoku Musou Eiketsuden
description: Players command legendary warriors from the Three Kingdoms era in this strategic action game that blends Dynasty Warriors combat with card-based tactical elements. Build and customize your deck of officer cards, each representing iconic heroes with unique abilities and fighting styles. Engage in intense battles where real-time action meets strategic card deployment, combining devastating combos with careful resource management. The game features both story campaigns following historical narratives and challenge modes testing tactical prowess. Collect hundreds of cards to create powerful synergies and dominate the battlefield.

title: Shinobido 2: Revenge of Zen
description: Players take on the role of Zen, a skilled ninja navigating a war-torn feudal Japan in this stealth-action sequel. The game features tactical assassination missions where you must choose which faction to support, directly influencing the balance of power between warring clans. Utilize a variety of ninja tools, weapons, and stealth techniques to complete contracts, eliminate targets, and survive in a world of political intrigue. Dynamic faction relationships mean your choices have lasting consequences on the game world and available missions.

This enhanced remake features improved artwork, additional scenarios, and expanded character routes. Navigate relationships with the enigmatic inhabitants of this strange land, including the Mad Hatter, the Cheshire Cat, and other unique personalities, as you uncover the secrets of this wonderful wonder world through multiple story paths and romantic possibilities.

Shiren the Wanderer: The Tower of Fortune and the Dice of Fate
description: Shiren the Wanderer returns in this roguelike RPG where every journey through the Tower of Fortune is different. Navigate randomly generated dungeons, manage limited resources, and adapt to ever-changing challenges. Death means losing items and progress, but knowledge gained helps in future attempts. Features turn-based combat, strategic item management, and the mysterious Dice of Fate mechanic that can alter dungeon layouts. Each expedition tests player skill and decision-making as Shiren climbs higher toward the tower's summit to change destiny itself.

title: Shiro to Kuro no Alice
description: Players enter a mysterious world inspired by Alice in Wonderland where they navigate a dark fantasy otome visual novel. The story follows a protagonist trapped between the White and Black kingdoms, making choices that determine relationships with various characters and multiple story outcomes. Features intricate character routes, decision-based branching narratives, and gothic artwork that explores themes of duality and moral ambiguity in a reimagined Wonderland setting.

Shovel Knight
description: Shovel Knight is a sweeping classic action-adventure game with awesome gameplay, memorable characters, and an 8-bit retro aesthetic. You play as the eponymous Shovel Knight, a small warrior with a huge quest. Shovel Knight has come to this land with two goals: to defeat the evil Enchantress and quest for his lost beloved. He wields a Shovel Blade, a multipurpose weapon whose techniques have now been lost to the ages. Jump and battle your way through a sprawling world of adventure filled with treasure, enemies, and devious traps.

Players must master timing and momentum while utilizing companion powers like gliding and creating platforms to navigate treacherous landscapes. With its stunning visuals, fluid controls, and escalating difficulty, Shu combines classic platforming mechanics with modern polish in a race against an unstoppable force of nature.

The quirky underwater adventure features multiple game modes and unlockable hats for maximum fish fashion.

title: Silent Hill: Book of Memories
description: Silent Hill: Book of Memories transforms the survival horror franchise into a dungeon-crawling action RPG experience. Players navigate procedurally-generated maze-like zones filled with nightmarish creatures from the Silent Hill universe. The story centers on a mysterious book that allows you to rewrite your past, but changing your memories has dangerous consequences. Features cooperative multiplayer for up to four players, character customization, and loot-based progression. Combat combines melee weapons, firearms, and puzzle-solving elements while maintaining the series' dark atmospheric horror.

The game features a compelling alternate history storyline, unique time manipulation abilities, and intense boss battles. With multiple playable characters, upgradeable weapons, and various game modes including Story and Arcade, it delivers a challenging experience that rewards both precision and strategy in its beautifully crafted steampunk world.

Navigate through diverse levels filled with food-themed challenges, hidden collectibles, and humorous characters. The unique eating mechanic allows Sir Eatsalot to consume various objects to overcome obstacles and defeat foes in creative ways.

As the master of Siralim, players build their ultimate team of creatures, unlock powerful artifacts, and explore an ever-changing realm filled with challenges and secrets.

description: Siralim 2 is a monster-catching RPG where players summon over 500 unique creatures to battle alongside them. Explore randomly generated dungeons, breed creatures to unlock rare species, and craft powerful artifacts. Build the ultimate team by combining creature abilities and traits in endless strategic combinations. Fight through procedurally generated realms, complete quests for the gods, and unlock new content. Features deep party customization, automated battle options, and extensive post-game content with no level cap.

description: Skullgirls 2nd Encore brings the acclaimed 2D fighting game to life with hand-drawn animations and a unique art style inspired by 1940s cartoons and film noir. Players battle through the Canopy Kingdom using a diverse cast of characters, each with distinctive movesets and combo systems. The game features traditional fighting mechanics with custom assist options, allowing teams of up to three fighters. With its deep gameplay systems, extensive tutorial mode, and competitive online multiplayer, this definitive edition adds new characters, stages, and story content to the original experience.

With its blend of old-school shoot-'em-up gameplay and contemporary graphics, it offers both nostalgic appeal and fresh challenges. Complete objectives to earn medals and unlock new content across diverse stages filled with intense aerial combat.

description: Slain: Back from Hell is a brutal heavy metal action platformer where you hack and slash through hordes of demonic creatures across gothic environments. As the warrior Bathoryn, you wield powerful swords and magic to battle through dungeons filled with deadly traps, pixel-art gore, and punishing boss fights. The game features challenging combat that demands precise timing and pattern recognition, complemented by a headbanging metal soundtrack. With its dark fantasy atmosphere, challenging difficulty, and retro-inspired visuals, this hack-and-slash adventure tests your skills across multiple nightmarish levels.

title: Slayaway Camp: Butcher's Cut
description: Slayaway Camp is a darkly comedic puzzle game inspired by 80s slasher films. Players control killers in a series of diorama-style murder puzzles where they must eliminate every victim without getting caught. The game features slide-based movement mechanics where characters move in straight lines until hitting an obstacle. With hundreds of levels across multiple horror-themed scenarios, unlockable killers, and gore-filled kill animations, it combines strategic puzzle-solving with tongue-in-cheek horror movie aesthetics and references to classic slasher franchises.

Players control Sly Cooper, a cunning raccoon thief, along with his tech-savvy turtle pal Bentley and musclebound hippo Murray. The first game follows the Cooper Gang as they recover pages from Sly's stolen family tome, the Thievius Raccoonus, facing off against the Fiendish Five. The second adventure expands the gameplay with multiple playable characters and heist mechanics as the team battles the Klaww Gang across international locations. Both titles feature cel-shaded visuals, stealth gameplay, collectibles, and witty dialogue.

title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves™
description: Sly Cooper and his gang return for another heist-filled adventure. Players control Sly and his crew—Bentley the brains and Murray the muscle—as they pull off elaborate thefts across global locations. Each character brings unique abilities to overcome guards, security systems, and rival criminals. The game blends stealth gameplay with platforming action, requiring careful planning and quick reflexes. Between missions, players explore open hub worlds, gathering clues and preparing for the next big score in this cel-shaded caper.

title: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves™
description: Sly Cooper and his gang return for their biggest heist yet. Players control multiple characters across various gameplay styles as they recruit specialists for an elaborate plan to crack the Cooper Vault. The game blends stealth, platforming, and mini-games across exotic locations, featuring the series' signature cel-shaded art style and humor. New additions include playable ancestors and expanded multiplayer options, though this is a port of the PS2 original.

title: Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time
description: Sly Cooper and the gang return for another heist in this time-traveling adventure. When the Thievius Raccoonus pages begin vanishing, Sly and his crew must jump through time to save their ancestors and preserve the Cooper legacy. Players control multiple characters across different time periods, utilizing each character's unique abilities to pull off elaborate heists. The cel-shaded visuals bring the cartoon world to life as you sneak, climb, and battle through colorful environments spanning from prehistoric times to the Old West.

When the Thievius Raccoonus pages begin mysteriously vanishing, Sly and his crew must journey through history to protect the Cooper legacy. Players navigate diverse time periods, switching between Sly and his ancestors, each with unique abilities. Master stealth mechanics, solve environmental puzzles, and pull off daring heists while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the Cooper bloodline. The cell-shaded art style brings vibrant worlds to life as players explore feudal Japan, the Wild West, and beyond.

Players sneak through detailed environments, pickpocket guards, and pull off daring heists while avoiding detection. The game combines stealth-based platforming with cartoon-style visuals and witty characters. Sly must track down the five members of the Fiendish Five who killed his father and took the family's secret techniques. The cel-shaded art style creates a comic book atmosphere as players master moves from recovered pages of the ancient thieving manual.

The game combines precise platforming with strategic stealth gameplay, challenging players to outwit enemies and collect treasures while unraveling a story of rivalry and redemption in a world of colorful animal characters.

Players compete for high scores across various mental exercises while tracking their performance and comparing results with friends. The game offers daily challenges and adapts difficulty based on player performance.

Master drifting, stunts, and power-ups to gain the edge. The demo showcases the game's innovative transformation mechanics and vibrant competitive racing action that made the full game a standout kart racer on PS Vita.

title: Sorcery Saga: Curse of the Great Curry God
description: Players guide Pupuru, a young sorceress, through randomly generated dungeons in this roguelike RPG adventure. The quest centers on gathering legendary ingredients to create the ultimate curry dish and save her mentor's struggling restaurant. Combat combines real-time movement with turn-based strategy as enemies move only when the player acts. Each dungeon run presents unique layouts, traps, and monster encounters, demanding careful resource management and tactical positioning to survive increasingly challenging floors and powerful bosses.

description: In a world where sorcerers are hunted and sacrificed, you wield forbidden magic to battle grotesque monsters. Every encounter demands a brutal choice: save fallen allies to preserve their souls, or sacrifice them for devastating power. Your decisions reshape your character's appearance and abilities, forging a path between salvation and damnation. Team up with other sorcerers to tackle massive beasts in this dark fantasy action RPG where every victory demands a sacrifice.

This enhanced version adds new factions, monsters, spells, and story content while refining the combat system. Team up with others to tackle challenging quests, collect offerings to craft powerful spells, and uncover the mysteries within the cursed book Librom as you decide what you're willing to sacrifice for power.

Space Hulk
description: Space Hulk brings the classic board game to life in a tense, claustrophobic tactical experience. You command a squad of Space Marine Terminators as they explore the labyrinthine corridors of a derelict space hulk, facing hordes of deadly Genestealers in brutal turn-based combat. Each mission demands careful positioning, resource management, and quick thinking as your heavily-armored warriors navigate tight passageways where death lurks around every corner. Based on the Warhammer 40,000 universe, this faithful adaptation captures the desperate atmosphere of the original game while adding cinematic presentation to every explosive encounter.

title: Sparkle
description: Players control a microorganism in the depths of the ocean, consuming smaller entities to grow while avoiding larger predators. The game features physics-based gameplay where strategic movement and timing are essential for survival. With over 90 levels spanning multiple game modes, players evolve their creature through various stages. The underwater environments are brought to life with ethereal music and luminescent visual effects. Challenge modes test mastery of the core mechanics while players navigate treacherous aquatic environments filled with both beauty and danger.

title: Sparkle 2
description: Sparkle 2 is a match-3 puzzle game where players launch colored orbs into a moving chain of orbs before they reach the end of the track. Match three or more orbs of the same color to eliminate them and prevent the chain from reaching its destination. The game features numerous levels with increasing difficulty, special power-ups, and multiple game modes. Players navigate through an enchanting fantasy world with mystical locations, collecting keys and unlocking new areas as they progress through challenging marble-popping action.

title: Sparkle Unleashed
description: Sparkle Unleashed brings marble-shooting puzzle action to your fingertips. Match three or more orbs of the same color as they roll along a winding path toward certain doom. Use power-ups strategically to create explosive chain reactions and prevent the orbs from reaching the end. Progress through numerous challenging levels, each with unique layouts and increasing difficulty. Master precision aiming and quick reflexes to achieve high scores and unlock new abilities. The fate of the world rests on your puzzle-solving skills as you unleash the power of the Sparkle to save civilization from destruction.

title: Spellspire
description: Spellspire combines word puzzle mechanics with RPG elements as players battle through a mysterious tower. Form words from a grid of letters to cast powerful spells and defeat monsters climbing floor by floor. Longer words create stronger attacks while strategic letter selection determines survival. Collect gold from defeated enemies to purchase upgraded equipment, new robes, and powerful wands. Each floor presents increasingly dangerous foes requiring careful vocabulary strategy. The tower holds 100 levels of escalating challenge, testing both spelling skills and tactical thinking in this unique blend of word game and dungeon crawler.

title: Spelunky
description: Spelunky is a challenging procedurally-generated platformer where players explore dangerous caves filled with traps, enemies, and treasure. Each run presents new layouts and challenges as you navigate through intricate levels, avoiding spike pits, hostile creatures, and deadly traps. The game features permadeath mechanics, meaning every mistake costs you dearly. Collect gold, rescue damsels, and discover secrets while mastering precise platforming and strategic decision-making. With its roguelike elements and unforgiving difficulty, Spelunky rewards careful observation and quick reflexes.

description: Players control Lucas, a Canadian farmer defending Earth against an alien invasion of spheroid enemies. Armed with a modified fertilizer cannon, you traverse colorful 2D platforming levels, rescuing citizens while battling the spheroid menace. The game features tight platforming mechanics across various environments, challenging players to master jump timing and weapon upgrades. With its quirky premise and retro-inspired gameplay, Spheroids delivers arcade-style action as you work to save humanity from the geometric invaders threatening the planet.

title: Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon
description: Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon challenges players to spin webs and catch insects across mysterious moonlit estates. As a spider, you explore abandoned mansions room by room, using your silk to craft strategic webs that ensnare flying prey. The game features dynamic weather systems and a day-night cycle that affect insect behavior patterns. Solve environmental puzzles, discover the secrets of the Blackbird Estate, and unlock new areas by completing web-spinning challenges. With physics-based gameplay and atmospheric exploration, you'll need both cunning and patience to master the art of the hunt.

description: Navigate through increasingly challenging levels in this minimalist action-puzzle game where players guide a small orb through hazardous environments filled with deadly obstacles. The objective is to splatter paint across the entire level while avoiding spikes, saw blades, and other lethal traps. With over 100 levels of escalating difficulty, precise timing and quick reflexes are essential. The game features a stark black-and-white aesthetic that bursts into color as players progress, creating a visually striking contrast. Multiple game modes and unlockable content provide additional replay value for puzzle enthusiasts seeking a true test of skill.

title: Spirit Hunter: NG
description: Spirit Hunter: NG continues the terrifying supernatural horror series with a new protagonist investigating deadly spirits in Tokyo. Players explore dark locations, gather clues, and make critical choices that determine survival. The game features multiple endings based on decisions made during encounters with vengeful ghosts. Using a smartphone interface, you communicate with allies and uncover the mysteries behind each spirit's curse. Atmospheric sound design and striking artwork create an immersive horror experience as you race to save victims from paranormal threats.

description: Players join SpongeBob and friends in this action-adventure game based on the second SpongeBob SquarePants movie. The gang gains superpowers and must work together to stop Plankton's army of robots. Switch between characters with unique abilities, solve puzzles, and battle through various levels in Bikini Bottom. Features cooperative gameplay and special powers for each character including SpongeBob, Patrick, Sandy, Squidward, and Mr. Krabs as they fight to save their underwater world.

The game features pixel art visuals, challenging puzzles that require timing and quick reflexes, and various disguises to unlock. Perfect your stealth skills through increasingly complex security systems while racing against the clock.

title: Spy Hunter
description: Spy Hunter brings high-octane vehicular combat to the PS Vita. Players take control of the iconic G-6155 Interceptor, a weaponized supercar capable of transforming into a watercraft. The game features intense chase sequences through urban environments and waterways, combining fast-paced racing with third-person shooter elements. Armed with an arsenal of weapons including machine guns, missiles, and smoke screens, players must complete dangerous missions while evading enemy forces. The Vita version includes on-the-go gameplay tailored for portable sessions.

The game features crisp visuals, faithful sound effects, and music from the films, delivering an arcade-style pinball experience that captures the essence of both the Star Wars saga and traditional pinball gameplay.

Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home? It won't be easy. Ever since Joja Corporation came to town, the old ways of life have all but disappeared. The community center, once the town's most vibrant hub of activity, now lies in shambles. But the valley seems full of opportunity. With a little dedication, you might just be the one to restore Stardew Valley to greatness.

Players navigate through asteroid fields, defend capital ships, and participate in large-scale fleet battles while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the galaxy.

Make choices that determine which romantic path to pursue in this entry of the popular Starry☆Sky series.

title: STAY
description: STAY is a unique narrative-driven adventure where you communicate with Quinn, a therapist trapped in a mysterious room. Your choices and presence matter as the game runs in real-time, even when you're away. Build a relationship through conversation, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the dark truth behind Quinn's imprisonment. The clock never stops ticking, and abandoning Quinn has consequences. Your decisions shape the story's outcome as you navigate psychological tension and moral dilemmas in this innovative blend of visual novel and adventure gameplay.

description: SteamWorld Dig is a platform mining adventure where players take control of Rusty, a lone mining steambot who arrives at an old mining town in great need. Dig through the old earth, gaining riches while uncovering the ancient threat that lurks below. The game combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and combat in procedurally generated mines. Players upgrade Rusty's abilities and equipment as they delve deeper, discovering secrets and facing increasingly dangerous enemies in the depths beneath the Western-themed robot town.

Players dig through destructible terrain, battle underground creatures, and explore an interconnected world filled with secrets. New abilities like the jackhammer and hook shot expand traversal options, while upgrades enhance Dorothy's combat and mining capabilities. The charming steampunk aesthetic, tight controls, and clever level design create an addictive loop of exploration and discovery. Puzzle-filled caves and challenging boss encounters punctuate the journey through diverse underground biomes.

title: SteamWorld Heist
description: Captain a ragtag crew of steam-powered robots through a galaxy of adventure and danger in this turn-based strategy game with a twist. Take aim in real-time as you fire ricocheting shots off walls and obstacles to defeat enemy robots and collect valuable loot. Recruit new crew members with unique abilities, upgrade your ship, and navigate procedurally generated levels filled with tactical challenges. The water is gone and only steam remains in this stylish sci-fi adventure where every shot counts and precision marksmanship meets strategic planning.

description: You are Rintaro Okabe, a self-proclaimed mad scientist who leads a group of friends in Akihabara. After accidentally discovering time travel through modified microwave experiments, you must navigate the consequences of changing the past. Each decision creates branching timelines with devastating effects on those you care about. Race against a mysterious organization while trying to prevent a dystopian future. Your choices determine who lives, who dies, and whether you can reach the perfect timeline where everyone survives.

What begins as playful experimentation spirals into a desperate struggle against fate itself when attempts to save friends from tragedy threaten to unravel reality. Navigate branching timelines, uncover dark conspiracies, and make heart-wrenching choices that determine who lives and dies. This acclaimed visual novel blends hard science fiction with emotional storytelling, challenging players to find a path to the ideal world line.

This visual novel features branching storylines determined by Okabe's phone interactions, exploring themes of despair, redemption, and the consequences of choice across multiple world lines as he faces a dark future.

The AR capabilities allow tags to be placed in real-world locations using the Vita's camera, blending digital art with physical spaces in an innovative gameplay experience.

The game features multiple vehicle classes, upgrade systems, and various game modes including championships and time trials. With its colorful visuals and arcade-style gameplay, it offers fast-paced competition across imaginative micro-scale tracks filled with obstacles and shortcuts.

title: Table Top Tanks

The blob grows larger as it consumes objects, gaining the ability to move heavier items and access new areas. This physics-based puzzle platformer combines precise touch controls with gravity-defying gameplay across dozens of increasingly challenging levels. Players tilt, rotate, and manipulate their environment while avoiding deadly hazards and outsmarting scientists. The blob's insatiable appetite drives it through a colorful world filled with creative challenges and satisfying destruction.

Ricochet balls off walls and objects to knock out all enemies in each level using skill shots and clever angles. The game features dozens of challenging levels with increasingly complex layouts, requiring precise aim and strategic thinking to create chain reactions and maximize destruction.

description: Terraria is a 2D sandbox adventure where players dig, build, and battle through procedurally generated worlds. Mine resources to craft weapons and armor, construct elaborate structures, and face off against challenging bosses. The Vita version brings the full Terraria experience to handheld, featuring the game's signature blend of exploration, crafting, and combat. With hundreds of items to discover and limitless building possibilities, each playthrough offers something new as you uncover the mysteries lurking in the depths below.

Master electromagnetic powers to repel and attract metal objects, reverse polarity, and overcome obstacles. Explore the abandoned tower's beautifully crafted 2D world without dialogue or text, as the story unfolds through environmental storytelling and atmospheric visuals.

When the protagonist discovers the truth about this artificial reality and realizes they've been trapped in a digital prison designed to fulfill humanity's desires for escape, they join the Go-Home Club, a group of students who wish to return to the real world. The game features a unique Imaginary Chain turn-based battle system where players can predict enemy actions and plan multi-character combo attacks, creating strategic depth as they fight to break free from Mobius.

title: The Count Lucanor
description: A young boy named Hans searches for his missing mother in a mysterious castle filled with deadly traps and riddles. Players must explore dark corridors, collect gold coins to bribe a kobold for information, and solve environmental puzzles while avoiding numerous fatal encounters. The game combines classic adventure elements with survival horror tension, as Hans has limited lives and must carefully choose which paths to take and which secrets to uncover in his quest to escape the Count's domain.

title: The Deer God
description: The Deer God is a breathtaking 3D pixel art adventure that follows a hunter who is reincarnated as a deer after a fateful encounter. Players must survive in a procedurally generated wilderness filled with dangerous predators, solve environmental puzzles, and make moral choices that affect karma. The game features a day-night cycle, seasonal changes, and the ability to unlock new powers and transformations. With its unique art style, atmospheric soundtrack, and themes of reincarnation and consequences, players navigate a mysterious world where every action has meaning and survival depends on wit and wisdom.

title: The Fruit of Grisaia: Side Episode
The House in Fata Morgana
description: A Gothic mystery spanning centuries unfolds within a cursed mansion. Players witness the tragic tales of those who lived and died in the house, piecing together a narrative that shifts through different time periods. Each chapter reveals dark secrets and twisted fates of the mansion's inhabitants. The story explores themes of love, betrayal, and redemption through multiple perspectives. Rich storytelling and haunting atmosphere combine with stunning artwork and an evocative soundtrack to create an unforgettable visual novel experience.

title: The Hungry Horde™
description: Lead a growing horde of zombies through the streets in this unique action puzzle game. Starting as a single zombie, you must infect humans to build your undead army while avoiding hazards and authorities. Use your expanding horde to overcome obstacles, reach safe zones, and wreak havoc across multiple levels. Strategic thinking meets arcade action as you manage your shambling mob through increasingly complex challenges, deciding when to split up your horde or keep them together for maximum impact.

title: The Idol Master: Music Clips
description: The Idolmaster Must Songs presents a compilation of music videos and rhythm gameplay featuring the beloved idols from the Idolmaster franchise. Players watch high-quality performances and engage with rhythm-based mechanics to popular songs from the series. The game showcases various idols performing their hit tracks with detailed animations and costumes. Fans can enjoy both the visual spectacle of the performances and the challenge of timing-based gameplay across multiple difficulty levels.

title: The IdolM@ster Must Songs - Ao-Ban
description: The IdolM@ster Must Songs presents a collection of classic songs from THE iDOLM@STER franchise in this Ao-Ban (Blue) edition for PS Vita. Players guide their favorite idols through rhythm-based performances, hitting notes in time with the music to deliver perfect shows. Features multiple difficulty levels, unlockable costumes, and beloved tracks that defined the series. Whether you're a longtime producer or new to 765 Production, this compilation delivers the essential musical experience that made THE iDOLM@STER a phenomenon in Japan's idol gaming scene.

title: THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97 GLOBAL MATCH
description: THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97 GLOBAL MATCH brings the classic SNK fighting game to modern platforms with enhanced features. This definitive version of KOF '97 includes both Advanced and Extra modes, allowing players to choose their preferred fighting style. The game features the complete roster of iconic fighters across multiple teams, engaging in fast-paced 3-on-3 team battles. Global Match adds online multiplayer with rollback netcode, gallery mode, and various quality-of-life improvements while preserving the intense combo-heavy gameplay that made the original a tournament favorite in the late 1990s arcade scene.

title: The Labyrinth of Grisaia -LE EDEN DE LA GRISAIA-
description: This visual novel continues the Grisaia trilogy, following protagonist Yuuji Kazami as he navigates complex relationships and dangerous situations. Players make choices that affect the story's outcome as they explore multiple character routes and uncover deeper mysteries surrounding the academy and its inhabitants. Features branching narratives, character development, and a mix of dramatic storytelling with lighter moments.

title: THE LAST BLADE 2
description: THE LAST BLADE 2 brings the legendary SNK weapon-based fighter to PS Vita. Choose from a diverse roster of fighters wielding katanas, spears, and other deadly weapons in this beautifully animated 2D fighting game set in Japan's Bakumatsu period. Master the Power and Speed fighting styles, execute devastating Super Desperation Moves, and experience intense one-on-one battles. The game features multiple gameplay modes including Story Mode, VS Mode, and Practice Mode. With its elegant art style, precise combat mechanics, and deep fighting system, THE LAST BLADE 2 stands as one of SNK's most refined fighting game experiences.

title: The Legend of Dark Witch -Chronicle 2D ACT-
description: Players take control of Zizou Olympia in this fast-paced 2D action platformer. Battle through stages collecting Tres (essences) from defeated bosses to power up abilities and weapons. Features challenging boss fights, multiple playable characters, and a gear system that allows customization of stats and abilities. The game combines classic Mega Man-style gameplay with modern anime aesthetics and a scoring system that rewards skillful play.

title: The Legend of Heroes AO NO KISEKI Evolution
description: The Legend of Heroes: Ao no Kiseki Evolution is an enhanced port of the Crossbell arc's second chapter. Players continue the story of Lloyd Bannings and the Special Support Section as they investigate crimes and uncover conspiracies threatening their city-state. This tactical RPG features turn-based combat with a strategic orbment system, allowing deep character customization. The Evolution version includes updated visuals, full voice acting, new character portraits, and additional story content. Players navigate political intrigue while building relationships with party members through a rich narrative experience.

title: The Legend of Heroes ZERO NO KISEKI Evolution
description: Experience the beginning of the Crossbell arc in this enhanced PlayStation Vita remake. Players follow Lloyd Bannings and the Special Support Section as they navigate the political tensions of Crossbell City, caught between two superpowers. The Evolution version features full voice acting, refined visuals, and additional story content. Engage in strategic turn-based combat, build relationships with party members, and uncover conspiracies in this critically acclaimed JRPG that sets the stage for an epic saga.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky FC Evolution Demo
The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky the Third Evolution
description: Delve into the depths of Phantasma in this enhanced PlayStation Vita version of the final chapter in the Sky trilogy. Kevin Graham, a member of the Septian Church's Gralsritter order, investigates a mysterious artifact that transports him and his companions to a surreal realm of trials. Battle through challenging dungeons, uncover the dark secrets of Kevin's past, and witness the untold stories of beloved characters from previous adventures. This Evolution release features enhanced visuals, new voice acting, and refined gameplay for the ultimate Trails experience.

title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES: TRAILS OF COLD STEEL
description: Rean Schwarzer enrolls at Thors Military Academy in Erebonia as a member of the newly formed Class VII. This diverse group of students must navigate political intrigue, master combat arts, and forge bonds while uncovering dark secrets threatening the empire. The game features tactical turn-based battles with the ARCUS system, allowing students to summon powerful Orbments. Players explore dungeons, complete quests, and strengthen relationships through a rich bonding system. As tensions rise between nobility and commoners, Class VII finds itself at the center of events that will shape Erebonia's future.

description: Players follow Rean Schwarzer, a new student at Thors Military Academy, as he joins Class VII and uncovers political intrigue threatening the Erebonian Empire. This tactical RPG features the ARCUS battle system, allowing students to harness mystical powers through Combat Links. Strategic turn-based combat combines with character bonding mechanics as Class VII navigates field studies across Erebonia. The story weaves personal relationships with grand political conspiracies, offering deep character development and worldbuilding. Master tactical positioning, exploit enemy weaknesses, and forge bonds that enhance combat abilities in this epic JRPG adventure.

title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES: TRAILS OF COLD STEEL II
description: Rean Schwarzer and Class VII return in this direct sequel to Trails of Cold Steel. The Erebonian civil war erupts across the nation as noble and reformist factions clash for control. Players reunite their scattered classmates while piloting Divine Knights in tactical mech battles. The story deepens the complex political intrigue of Erebonia while exploring character relationships through bonding events. This expansive JRPG features turn-based combat with the tactical link system, allowing coordinated attacks between party members for devastating combination strikes.

description: Rean Schwarzer and Class VII return in this direct sequel to Trails of Cold Steel. After the October War and the occupation of Erebonia, Rean awakens to find his friends scattered across the nation. Players navigate a country in turmoil, reuniting with classmates while uncovering the secrets behind the Erebonian civil war. The game features turn-based combat with the tactical link system, extensive character development, and political intrigue across a vast continent. Multiple story threads converge as players explore dungeons, complete quests, and engage in strategic battles using Arts, Crafts, and powerful S-Crafts.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel II Demo
The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure Evolution
description: Experience the epic conclusion of the Crossbell arc in this enhanced Evolution version of Trails to Azure. Players control Lloyd Bannings and the Special Support Section as they face political conspiracies and supernatural threats in the autonomous state of Crossbell. This tactical RPG features the series' acclaimed turn-based combat system, deep character development, and an intricate story that builds upon Trails from Zero. The Evolution version includes full voice acting, enhanced graphics, and new story content, making it the definitive way to experience this beloved entry in the Trails series.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Zero no Kiseki Evolution Free Version
description: Players join Lloyd Bannings and the Special Support Section as they investigate mysteries in the city-state of Crossbell. This free trial version introduces the opening chapters of the beloved Japanese RPG, featuring tactical turn-based combat, character-driven storytelling, and an expansive world to explore. The Evolution edition enhances the original with full voice acting, new character portraits, and additional story content.

title: The Lego Movie Videogame
description: Everything is awesome in this brick-building adventure based on the hit film. Players control Emmet and other Master Builders as they journey through 15 levels spanning key locations from the movie. The game combines LEGO's signature humor with action-platforming gameplay, puzzle-solving, and vehicle sections. Build constructions from instruction pages, collect studs and minikits, and unlock over 90 playable characters. Features drop-in/drop-out co-op multiplayer and the ability to free-build creations. Relive the movie's story while smashing, building, and exploring the LEGO universe.

title: The LEGO® Movie - Videogame
description: Players experience the events of The LEGO Movie in brick-built form, controlling Emmet and other Master Builders as they attempt to stop Lord Business from destroying the universe. The game features signature LEGO humor and gameplay, with players collecting studs, building objects, and solving puzzles across various realms. Characters utilize unique abilities to overcome obstacles and battle enemies. The adventure takes players through iconic movie locations, from Bricksburg to Cloud Cuckoo Land, combining platforming, combat, and construction mechanics in classic LEGO game style.

title: The Long Reach
description: The Long Reach is a horror adventure game set in New Hampshire. Players navigate a psychological thriller where reality blurs with nightmare as they uncover the dark secrets of the Baervox research facility. The game features pixel art visuals and explores themes of science gone wrong, with inhabitants of a small town transforming into grotesque versions of themselves. Solve environmental puzzles, avoid dangers, and piece together what happened in this atmospheric thriller that questions the nature of consciousness and experimentation.

title: The Longest Five Minutes
description: In this unique RPG, you play as a hero who has lost his memories at the final battle against the Demon King. As the climactic fight unfolds in real-time, fragmented memories of your five-year journey return through flashbacks. You must complete these memory sequences to unlock the skills and strength needed to defeat the boss. The game cleverly interweaves turn-based RPG gameplay in the past with the desperate present-day struggle, creating a narrative where remembering the journey is just as important as finishing it. Every dungeon explored and battle fought in your memories directly impacts your ability to save the world.

title: The Longest Five Minutes Demo
description: Players follow Flash Back and his party as they battle the Demon King, but there's a twist - Flash has lost his memories. The demo introduces the unique memory mechanic where combat encounters trigger flashbacks that reveal the story in reverse chronological order. Players experience key moments from Flash's journey while piecing together how he arrived at the final confrontation. The turn-based combat system combines traditional JRPG elements with the narrative-driven flashback structure that defines this quirky adventure.

title: The Lost Child
description: The Lost Child is a dungeon-crawling RPG where an occult journalist investigates mysterious events in modern-day Tokyo and Shinjuku. Players explore labyrinthine dungeons, battle demons and angels using a turn-based combat system, and recruit defeated enemies as Astrals to fight alongside them. The game features a deep story involving religious mythology, multiple endings based on player choices, and extensive character customization. With its first-person perspective and strategic gameplay, it challenges players to uncover the truth behind supernatural occurrences while managing a party of collected creatures in their quest to prevent an apocalyptic scenario.

title: The Muppets Movie Adventures
description: Join Kermit, Miss Piggy, and the entire Muppets gang in this family-friendly adventure based on the 2014 Muppets film. Players navigate through various movie-themed levels, solving puzzles and engaging in action sequences while experiencing the humor and charm that defines the Muppets franchise. The game features multiple playable characters, each with unique abilities, allowing players to switch between Muppets to overcome obstacles and progress through the story. Designed for younger audiences, it combines platforming elements with light puzzle-solving in a colorful, accessible package that captures the spirit of the beloved characters and their cinematic adventure.

title: The Princess Guide
description: In this action RPG, players take on the role of a knight tasked with guiding four princesses who lead their own armies. The game combines real-time combat with strategic elements as you train and mentor these royal leaders, each with distinct personalities and fighting styles. Battle through various missions while managing relationships and developing your proteges' abilities. The mentor system allows you to shape how each princess grows in power and temperament. Features colorful anime-style visuals and a lighthearted tone mixed with tactical depth.

title: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2
The Swapper
description: You control a character armed with a cloning gun capable of creating up to four copies of yourself simultaneously. These clones mimic your every move, allowing you to solve increasingly complex environmental puzzles. Death is temporary—swap your consciousness into any living clone to continue. Navigate through abandoned space station corridors filled with mysterious machinery and philosophical conundrums. The station holds dark secrets about consciousness, identity, and what it means to be human. Each puzzle challenges your spatial reasoning and forces you to think several steps ahead.

title: The Swindle
description: The Swindle is a steampunk cybercrime caper where you break into buildings, steal cash, and hack security systems. Players have 100 days to pull off the ultimate heist on Scotland Yard's mainframe computer before it goes online and ruins crime forever. Each procedurally-generated level presents a unique challenge as you control expendable thieves, upgrading their skills and equipment between runs. Death is permanent, losing all progress from that burglar, creating tension with every jump and security encounter in this roguelike platformer.

title: The Unfinished Swan
description: The Unfinished Swan is a first-person painting adventure where players explore a mysterious, all-white kingdom by splattering paint to reveal the world around them. Starting in a blank void, players throw paint to uncover hidden paths, architecture, and secrets while following a swan into a surreal storybook realm. The game tells the tale of a boy named Monroe who chases after a swan that escaped from an unfinished painting left by his late mother. Through creative environmental puzzles and evolving gameplay mechanics across different chapters, players gradually piece together the story of a king who could create anything but never finish what he started.

title: The Walking Dead
description: Players guide Lee Everett, a convicted criminal given a second chance at redemption in a world devastated by the undead. This episodic adventure focuses on difficult moral choices and their consequences as Lee protects a young girl named Clementine. Every decision shapes the story and determines who lives or dies. The game emphasizes character development and emotional storytelling over action, creating a tense narrative experience where relationships matter as much as survival. Based on Robert Kirkman's comic series, this tale explores what it means to retain humanity when civilization crumbles.

description: The Walking Dead: Season Two continues Clementine's journey as she navigates a brutal post-apocalyptic world filled with undead walkers and dangerous survivors. Players make critical choices that shape the story and determine who lives or dies. This episodic adventure features Telltale's signature branching narrative and moral dilemmas. Clementine must rely on her wits and survival skills learned from Lee as she searches for safety in a world where trust is a rare commodity. The season explores themes of loss, family, and what it means to retain humanity when civilization has collapsed.

title: The Wolf Among Us
description: Step into the shoes of Bigby Wolf, the big bad wolf now serving as sheriff of Fabletown. Navigate a dark noir mystery where fairytale characters live in exile among humans in 1980s New York City. Your choices shape relationships and determine who lives or dies as you investigate a brutal murder that threatens to expose the secret community. Experience Telltale's signature episodic storytelling based on the acclaimed Fables comic series, where every decision carries weight and moral lines blur in this gritty urban fantasy tale.

title: Thomas Was Alone
description: Thomas Was Alone tells the story of the world's first sentient AIs, with players guiding a group of uniquely shaped rectangles through a series of puzzling platforming challenges. Each character possesses distinct abilities and personalities, revealed through charming narration. Players must use teamwork and creative thinking to navigate increasingly complex levels, stacking characters, jumping gaps, and solving environmental puzzles. The minimalist visual style combines with an acclaimed soundtrack and witty writing to create an unexpectedly emotional journey about friendship, cooperation, and self-discovery.

title: Three Fourths Home
description: In this experimental visual novel, you play as Kelly during a drive home through rural Nebraska. A thunderstorm looms as you navigate a conversation with your family over the phone, exploring themes of identity, change, and the complexities of returning home. The narrative unfolds entirely through dialogue choices as you drive, with the storm serving as both literal threat and metaphor. Your responses shape the story's emotional trajectory as Kelly reconnects with her mother, father, and younger brother, each dealing with their own struggles in this intimate character study.

title: Three Fourths Home (Extended Edition)
description: Three Fourths Home: Extended Edition tells the story of Kelly, a young woman who returns to her family's farmhouse in rural Nebraska during a fierce storm. Players guide Kelly through a phone conversation with her family as she drives down an empty highway, making dialogue choices that shape the narrative. This expanded edition includes the epilogue Idling in the Rubble, which explores Kelly's life after the main story. The visual novel combines minimalist black-and-white visuals with ambient sound design to create an intimate exploration of family dynamics, mental health, and the meaning of home.

title: Thunder Paw
description: Thunder Paw is a 2D side-scrolling action platformer where players control a heroic dog on a mission to rescue his siblings from the evil Gib and his robot army. Players dash, jump, and shoot their way through colorful levels filled with enemies and obstacles. The game features retro-inspired pixel art graphics, fast-paced gameplay, and boss battles. With its accessible controls and family-friendly presentation, Thunder Paw delivers a lighthearted adventure that pays homage to classic platforming games while adding its own unique canine twist to the formula.

description: Thy Sword is a retro-inspired hack-and-slash action platformer that channels classic 8-bit aesthetics. Players control a warrior battling through hordes of monsters across challenging stages filled with traps, boss encounters, and environmental hazards. The game features pixel art graphics, tight combat mechanics emphasizing melee attacks and dodging, and a high difficulty curve that demands precise timing and pattern recognition. With its old-school presentation and unforgiving gameplay, Thy Sword appeals to fans of vintage action games seeking a nostalgic yet demanding experience.

title: Time Recoil
description: Time Recoil is a top-down shooter where killing enemies slows down time. Players control a member of the Recoilers, using time manipulation abilities to execute devastating slow-motion kills. Chain together kills to activate increasingly powerful special moves and time-bending powers. Fight through a story-driven campaign to prevent a mad scientist from destroying the fabric of time itself. Features fast-paced combat, brutal action sequences, and strategic time mechanics that reward aggressive playstyles.

title: TIME TRAVELERS
description: TIME TRAVELERS is an adventure game where players experience interconnected stories across multiple characters in Tokyo. The narrative revolves around a mysterious incident that threatens the city, and players must make choices that affect the timeline and determine the fate of the protagonists. The game features anime-style visuals and branching storylines that encourage multiple playthroughs to uncover all the secrets and achieve the true ending.

title: Timespinner
description: Travel through time to prevent a devastating war in this pixel-art Metroidvania. As Lunais, use the Timespinner to stop, slow, and rewind time while exploring a vast interconnected world. Battle through the Lachiem Empire, unlock new abilities, and discover the truth about your mother's mysterious past. Features deep RPG mechanics, multiple endings, and the ability to summon familiars to aid in combat.

description: Tiny Troopers Joint Ops combines two games in one package, delivering bite-sized military action on the go. Players command a squad of miniature soldiers through over 60 missions across zombie-infested territories and hostile war zones. The game features strategic squad-based combat where players upgrade their troopers, unlock weapons, and deploy special abilities like air strikes and medical support. With its accessible twin-stick shooter mechanics and progression system, the game offers quick tactical engagements perfect for portable play sessions.

title: Titan Attacks!
description: Titan Attacks! is a modern reimagining of classic arcade space shooters. Players defend Earth against an alien invasion across the solar system, battling through waves of enemies from Mars to Saturn and beyond. The game features strategic depth through an upgrade system where players purchase weapons, shields, and power-ups between levels. With its retro-styled graphics, challenging gameplay, and persistent progression system, Titan Attacks! combines nostalgic arcade action with contemporary game design. Players must carefully manage their earnings to build the ultimate battleship capable of defeating the final Titan mothership.

title: Titan Souls
description: Players face off against colossal titans in this minimalist boss battle game. Armed with a single arrow and a roll to dodge attacks, the hero must discover each titan's unique weakness and strike with precision. The game features atmospheric exploration across windswept ruins and mysterious landscapes between intense one-on-one encounters. Death comes swiftly, but respawning is instant, encouraging experimentation with different tactics. With its pixel art aesthetic and haunting soundtrack, the experience blends challenging combat with a contemplative journey through a fallen world where gods and monsters still roam.

Players build and customize a party of adventurers, each with unique abilities and classes, to tackle increasingly challenging dungeons. The game features extensive character development systems, strategic party formation mechanics, and anime-style presentation. Originally released in Japan as part of the Dungeon Travelers series, this entry offers deep tactical gameplay where proper party composition and resource management are essential for survival in the dangerous depths.

Tokyo Clanpool
description: Tokyo Clanpool is a dungeon-crawling RPG set beneath modern-day Tokyo. Players lead a party of characters exploring procedurally generated dungeons filled with monsters and treasures. The game features a unique clan system where party members belong to different factions, affecting relationships and abilities. Combat combines turn-based strategy with positioning mechanics, and the story blends contemporary Tokyo culture with fantasy dungeon exploration. Players manage resources, upgrade equipment, and navigate both interpersonal drama and dangerous underground labyrinths in this Japanese dungeon RPG.

title: Tokyo Onmyouji: Tengen Jibashi - Rei no Baai - V Edition
TOKYO TATTOO GIRLS
description: Take control of Tokyo's 23 wards in this unique strategy game where tattoos are power. As the boss of a girl gang, you expand your territory through tactical battles and resource management. Each of your tattooed girls possesses special abilities that can be deployed strategically across the map. Compete against rival gangs to dominate districts, build influence, and ultimately rule all of Tokyo. The game blends territory conquest with visual novel elements, featuring distinct characters and gang dynamics. Navigate the underground world where ink equals strength and reputation is everything.

An inventory system with over 100 weapons and 70 armor pieces allows extensive customization. Daniel must level up, learn spells, complete quests, and uncover the castle's mysteries while dealing with a demon possessing his body. The game features humorous dialogue and gaming culture references.

The game features a unique 'Panty Gauge' system where successful combos and flashy moves increase spectator enthusiasm, unlocking devastating special attacks. Combat is fast-paced with juggling mechanics, aerial combos, and environmental interactions. Multiple playable characters offer different fighting styles as you progress through the story mode.

The game emphasizes precision control and strategic use of acceleration and balance to conquer increasingly difficult courses packed with creative obstacles.

title: Utawarerumono: Mask of Deception
description: Utawarerumono: Mask of Deception combines visual novel storytelling with tactical RPG combat. Players follow Haku, an amnesiac man who awakens in a fantasy world and becomes embroiled in political intrigue. The game features a deep narrative with memorable characters, strategic turn-based battles on grid-based maps, and stunning artwork. As Haku navigates this mysterious land inhabited by people with animal features, he must forge alliances and uncover secrets that will determine the fate of nations. This entry serves as both a standalone story and the beginning of a duology.

Navigate the seedy underworld, build relationships with NPCs, and take on challenging quests to earn your freedom from this lawless realm where only the strong survive.

Fast-paced action combines historical Japanese aesthetics with sci-fi mechs in this bullet-filled tribute to classic arcade shooters.

description: Vegas Party brings mini-game party action to the PlayStation Vita. Players compete in various casino-themed mini-games and challenges set in Las Vegas. The game features touch screen and motion controls utilizing the Vita's unique capabilities. Compete against friends or AI opponents in games inspired by blackjack, poker, slots, and other casino activities. Customize your avatar and work your way through different Vegas venues to become the ultimate party champion.

title: Velocibox
description: Velocibox is a brutally difficult twitch-based action game that tests players' reflexes to their absolute limits. Navigate a small cube through increasingly hostile neon-colored tunnels at breakneck speeds, dodging obstacles and collecting pickups while the environment constantly shifts and rotates. Each run demands split-second decisions as walls, barriers, and deadly traps materialize with little warning. The minimalist visual design belies the punishing difficulty, where a single mistake sends players back to the beginning. Master precise movements through six grueling stages of pure, adrenaline-fueled challenge.

description: Velocity Ultra is a fast-paced top-down space shooter that combines shoot-em-up action with puzzle-solving elements. Players pilot the Quarp Jet through challenging vertical-scrolling levels, utilizing unique teleportation mechanics and time manipulation abilities to navigate complex environments. The game features precision-based gameplay where quick reflexes and strategic thinking are essential to rescue stranded survivors, solve spatial puzzles, and achieve the fastest completion times. With its blend of arcade action, brain-teasing challenges, and score-chasing gameplay, Velocity Ultra delivers an addictive experience.

The sequel to 999: Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors features branching paths determined by key decisions, multiple endings, and a gripping story that explores themes of trust, sacrifice, and the nature of consciousness across parallel worlds.

description: Vitamin Z follows a group of students at the prestigious Kainin High School as they navigate their final year. Players take on the role of a female transfer student who joins B-Class, where she encounters various male classmates with distinct personalities. Through visual novel gameplay, choices shape relationships and determine which romantic route to pursue. The game features multiple story paths, character events, and endings based on player decisions throughout the school year.

Players control the titular Viking warrior as he battles through mythological landscapes filled with dangerous creatures and deadly traps. With precise controls and unforgiving difficulty, the game demands mastery of its combat mechanics and pixel-perfect jumping. Death is frequent, but checkpoints allow players to restart sections without losing all progress. The game features hand-drawn pixel art graphics, epic boss battles, and multiple paths to explore. Success requires patience, timing, and the determination to overcome its brutal challenges.

You guide Locksley through 100 levels of a virtual training simulation, using gadgets and wit to outsmart advanced AI guards. The game challenges you to navigate complex environments, avoid detection, and master the art of stealth to steal from the rich and teach the poor how to survive. With minimalist visuals and strategic gameplay, each level presents new tactical puzzles where sound, line of sight, and clever use of tools determine success or failure in this modern take on rebellion.
