Instead of jumping, players reverse gravity to navigate treacherous spike-filled rooms and solve intricate environmental puzzles. The game features a chiptune soundtrack, challenging level design that emphasizes precision and timing, and a distinctive minimalist aesthetic. With its focus on exploration and player-created checkpoints, VVVVVV offers a uniquely challenging experience that tests reflexes and spatial reasoning.

title: Wake-up Club
description: Wake-up Club is a social alarm clock application for PS Vita that turns waking up into a multiplayer experience. Players set their alarms and join clubs with friends or other players worldwide, earning points for waking up on time and completing morning mini-games. The application tracks wake-up consistency, awards trophies for dedication, and creates a community around the simple act of starting your day. With charming presentation and cheerful music, it transforms the mundane morning routine into an engaging social activity that encourages accountability and connection with fellow early risers across the globe.

Through story choices and character interactions, shape your destiny and explore multiple romantic paths in this enchanting tale of self-discovery, friendship, and the power of belief in oneself.

title: Warlock's Tower
description: Warlock's Tower is a retro-styled puzzle game where players control Tim, a humble mailman tasked with delivering a package to the top of a mysterious tower. Every step taken drains one unit of Tim's health, creating a unique grid-based puzzle mechanic where careful planning is essential. Players must navigate through increasingly challenging floors, collecting health potions and avoiding hazards while managing their limited movements. The game features charming pixel art, clever level design, and a quirky narrative that unfolds as Tim ascends the tower to confront the warlock waiting at its peak.

title: Warriors All-Stars
description: Warriors All-Stars brings together iconic characters from various Koei Tecmo franchises in an epic crossover musou experience. Players select from a diverse roster of heroes including warriors from Dynasty Warriors, Samurai Warriors, Ninja Gaiden, Dead or Alive, and more beloved series. The game features fast-paced hack-and-slash combat across fantasy battlefields where thousands of enemies fall before your attacks. Team up with your favorite characters, unleash devastating combos and special abilities, and unite different worlds to face a common threat. Multiple story paths and character interactions provide replay value in this celebration of Koei Tecmo's rich gaming legacy.

title: Warriors Orochi 2 Ultimate
description: Warriors Orochi 2 Ultimate brings together heroes from Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors in an epic crossover adventure. Players battle through alternate dimensions as the Orochi army threatens all of existence, commanding teams of three warriors with unique abilities. The Ultimate edition includes all previous DLC, new story chapters, and enhanced graphics for PS Vita. Master devastating combo attacks, unlock dozens of legendary warriors, and experience both historical and mythological warfare in this action-packed musou experience.

title: WARRIORS OROCHI 3 Ultimate
description: Warriors Orochi 3 Ultimate expands the epic crossover between Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors with new storylines, characters, and enhanced gameplay. Players command massive armies across chaotic battlefields, switching between three warriors in real-time to unleash devastating combos and special attacks. The Ultimate edition adds new playable characters including Shennong and Tamamo, plus additional story chapters that expand the time-traveling narrative. With over 120 playable characters, online co-op modes, and the signature musou action of clearing hundreds of enemies, this definitive version offers the most comprehensive Warriors Orochi experience.

title: WE ARE DOOMED
description: WE ARE DOOMED is a twin-stick shooter where waves of geometric enemies descend upon the player. Armed with a laser beam weapon and a screen-clearing super beam called The WAVE, players must survive increasingly intense waves of glowing shapes. The game features a minimalist neon aesthetic with pulsing electronic music. Each session challenges reflexes and pattern recognition as enemy formations grow more complex and aggressive. Score multipliers reward risky close-range combat, while strategic use of The WAVE creates breathing room during overwhelming assaults.

title: Welcome Park
description: Welcome Park serves as an interactive introduction to the PlayStation Vita's hardware capabilities. Players navigate through a series of mini-games designed to demonstrate the system's unique features, including the touchscreen, rear touch pad, motion sensors, cameras, and microphone. Each activity showcases a different aspect of the Vita's functionality while teaching players how to utilize these features in games. The experience acts as both a technical demonstration and a playful tutorial, helping new Vita owners become familiar with the handheld's innovative control methods through hands-on experimentation.

title: What Did I Do to Deserve This, My Lord?
description: Players take on the role of a God of Destruction, digging dungeons and creating monsters to defend against waves of heroes trying to invade. This unique tower defense strategy game flips the script by putting players on the villain's side. Excavate strategically to create effective dungeon layouts, mutate and evolve creatures to counter different hero types, and protect the Overlord at all costs. Features humorous dialogue, quirky characters, and addictive gameplay that rewards careful planning and quick thinking as heroes of increasing strength attempt to cleanse the dungeon.

title: When Vikings Attack!
description: When Vikings Attack! is a chaotic action game where players defend British cities from invading Vikings by picking up and hurling everyday objects at the Norsemen. Up to four players work together to grab cars, benches, phone booths, and other street furniture to fend off waves of attacking Vikings across colorful urban environments. The game combines frantic cooperative gameplay with strategic positioning as players must stay in lit areas while coordinating their attacks. Success requires teamwork, quick reflexes, and creative use of the environment to repel the relentless Viking hordes threatening to overrun the cities.

title: When Vikings Attack!™

Play solo or team up with friends in local cooperative multiplayer to repel the Norse menace. The game features a distinctive art style and progressively challenging levels as the Viking hordes grow more aggressive and numerous.

description: Young Elena Elkhorn embarks on a harrowing journey through an abandoned mansion to uncover the truth behind her father's disappearance. Using her inherited shamanic powers, she can separate her spirit from her body to communicate with ghosts, solve environmental puzzles, and navigate the estate's dark corridors. As she explores the grounds, she uncovers the tragic history of the Willows family and the sinister events that transpired on this cursed land. Players guide Elena through atmospheric 2D environments, piecing together notes and memories while avoiding supernatural dangers that lurk in the shadows.

title: White Album 2: Shiawase no Mukougawa
description: White Album 2: Shiawase no Mukougawa is the PlayStation Vita port of the acclaimed visual novel. Players follow the complex romantic entanglements of high school students as they navigate music, friendship, and love. The story focuses on the light music club and explores themes of unfulfilled desires and difficult choices. Featuring multiple routes and endings, this emotional narrative delivers branching storylines with consequences that ripple throughout the game. The experience combines compelling character development with dramatic storytelling in this sequel to the original White Album.

title: Windjammers
description: Windjammers brings the classic arcade disc-throwing sport to a new generation. Players compete in fast-paced matches on colorful courts, hurling a flying disc past opponents to score points. Master curved shots, powerful smashes, and defensive techniques across multiple arenas with unique layouts. Choose from international athletes, each with distinct stats and special moves. The game combines reflexes, strategy, and timing as you predict trajectories and position yourself for devastating counterattacks in this beloved competitive experience.

title: WipEout® 2048

Set in the year 2048 during the formation of the anti-gravity racing league, players pilot futuristic craft through the streets and skyways of Nova State City. Master hairpin turns, utilize devastating weapons, and compete across multiple race modes including Zone events that push reflexes to the limit. The game features online multiplayer, cross-platform play with PS3, and showcases the Vita's capabilities with touch controls and augmented reality features in this high-octane racing experience.

The atmospheric soundtrack and retro aesthetic create an unsettling experience as you navigate through rooms, interact with objects, and piece together the story. Players must make careful decisions that will determine their fate in this psychological horror experience.

The game features classic first-person exploration through labyrinthine dungeons, turn-based combat, and party management as adventurers uncover the secrets of the imprisoned souls. Character customization and strategic battles are key to surviving the dangerous depths while unraveling the dark mysteries that bind the spirits to this forsaken place.

Character customization allows for diverse party compositions, while strategic combat demands careful resource management and tactical decision-making. The dungeon's multiple floors present escalating challenges, hidden treasures, and powerful bosses that test even experienced adventurers.

description: Woah Dave! is a frantic arcade platformer where players control Dave as he attempts to defeat aliens by hurling explosive eggs and skulls at them. Set across single-screen levels, Dave must manage spawning threats while collecting coins and avoiding lava. The fast-paced gameplay emphasizes quick reflexes and risk-reward decisions as explosive hazards can help or harm. With retro-inspired pixel art and increasingly chaotic action, players compete for high scores while navigating the dangerous platforms and timing their throws carefully to survive each wave.

Players work through increasingly complex grids, discovering hidden words and unraveling the path through each carefully designed puzzle. With its simple mechanics and extensive puzzle collection, Word Maze provides an accessible word game experience perfect for short sessions or extended play.

Set in the fictional Mihate Town, you play as a transfer student who becomes entangled in a supernatural mystery involving the Dead Man's Tunnel and a cycle of tragedy that repeats each summer. Interact with various characters, uncover secrets, and make choices that determine multiple story paths and endings. The game blends mystery, romance, and horror elements as you race to solve the truth before the summer ends.

description: Embark on a magical journey through the land of Grymoire, where classic Final Fantasy monsters have been transformed into adorable mirages. Explore nostalgic worlds, encounter beloved characters from across the Final Fantasy series, and uncover the mystery of the twins' forgotten past. With charming chibi art style and deep combat mechanics, this adventure blends whimsy with classic JRPG depth in a celebration of Final Fantasy's rich legacy.

Players follow Touya Kagari, a high school student whose life changes when he encounters a mysterious girl named Es. The game features a unique storytelling system called the TOi (Technology of Interest) system, where players collect story fragments to unlock different narrative paths and endings. Rich anime-style artwork and voice acting bring the complex sci-fi narrative to life as players uncover secrets about the Azure, the Unions, and ancient technology.

description: XBLAZE Lost: Memories continues the BlazBlue spinoff visual novel series, following the enigmatic Me, a girl with no memories who awakens in a mysterious world. Players build and manage a secret base, research advanced technologies, and lead tactical turn-based combat missions across the globe. The war intensifies as enemies adapt to tactics, forcing constant strategic evolution in this portable version of the acclaimed strategy game.

The game supports solo play or two-player local co-op, offering arcade-style action with modern refinements to the retro shooter formula.

Each mission presents procedurally generated enemy waves and attack patterns, ensuring varied gameplay. Players must manage their squadron's upgrades and repairs between missions while facing increasingly challenging alien forces across multiple star systems.

description: Ys Origin takes players 700 years before the events of Ys I & II, revealing the secrets behind the legendary kingdom of Ys. This action-RPG features fast-paced real-time combat, challenging boss battles, and multiple playthroughs that unlock new perspectives on the story. The game combines classic Ys gameplay with refined mechanics, offering an accessible yet deep experience for both newcomers and series veterans.

title: Ys VIII -Lacrimosa of DANA-

Build a village with fellow survivors, map uncharted territories, and master the party-based battle system featuring dodging, blocking, and special attacks. The interconnected storylines reveal the island's dark history and Dana's crucial role in an impending catastrophe that threatens both timelines.
